Source:
Before entering Ghroth Island, Chaos was an Anomaly Hunter on a small island, where he went by his old name, Conrak. Eventually, he would abandon the name he received from his parents like a sunken boat in the sea.

Conrak once got into a shipwreck with another 11 crewmates. They found themselves in an ocean isolated from the world.
There was an archipelago in the ocean, which didn't even have internet access. Conrak and his crewmates settled on one of the islands but never stopped wanting to go back. Unfortunately, no islander was willing to leave their home to ferry them across unknown waters, and no outside vessels passed through the islands. The group decided to build a ship and sail home by themselves. They named the ship "the Boulder."
Once they built the Boulder, the group began to save up supplies for their return trip. For two years, the group navigated the Boulder around the islands to transport goods for funds. Since the group members were also Anomaly Hunters, they often took commissions, solving many issues that plagued the islanders. Gradually the "Boulder Hunters" became known local heroes.
In the end, because the group lived peacefully on the islands and was praised as heroes, some of them no longer wished to risk another adventure to return. Only five of them decided to go back.

However, on its return journey, the Boulder went through a storm. Conrak fell into the sea, and his companions weren't able to find him.
Luckily, Conrak fell into the sea near Ghroth Island and was saved by an Undertaker from the Island.
Once he formally joined Ghroth Island, Conrak changed his name to Chaos.
Translation: Prima di arrivare all'Isola di Ghroth, Chaos era un Cacciatore di Anomalie su una piccola isola, dove si faceva chiamare con il suo vecchio nome, Conrak. Alla fine, avrebbe abbandonato il nome ricevuto dai genitori come una barca affondata in mare.

Source:
A child prodigy; the "golden kid;" "the boy kissed by the god of wisdom."

The day Edgar came back from Twinkle School of Espers, aunts, uncles, neighbors, and their children all swarmed in droves to congratulate him, nearly trampling down his family's doorstep. Whether they came out of curiosity to see what made this so-called "neighbor's kid you should learn from" so special, or were reluctant children dragged along by parents demanding they "learn from his example," they all reached the same conclusion:
He really didn't look like anything special.

Meanwhile, Edgar found himself surrounded by adults, completely overwhelmed. He just couldn't keep up with their overlapping chatter. As they talked over each other, Edgar's future became crystal clear in their minds: he'd immediately become a star researcher at Zerogon Laboratory, the rising star of Yggash Court, the new director of the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Pink Paws Bank's job offer was worth considering too. With Edgar's abilities, why would't he become a board member at PPB? Of course, when the time came, he shouldn't forget to give a helping hand to that kid living diagonally across from him whose grades barely scraped by in every subject…

The adults listing out and arranging all these bright futures for him had become completely lost in their own fantasies. It was as if Edgar were their own child, fulfilling all the dreams they, themselves, couldn't…

Edgar looked around helplessly, unable to join any conversation. He was so nervous he pulled his scarf up high, wishing he could hide completely inside it. Luckily, at that very moment, his father squeezed through the crowd and patted his shoulder: "What do you want to be when you grow up, Edgar?"

Encouraged by his father's gaze, Edgar said softly:
"I… I just want to be Edgar."
Translation: Un bambino prodigio; il "ragazzo d'oro"; "il fanciullo baciato dal dio della sapienza".

Source:
She had never known that a daffodil grew in the center of the lake. She had never seen it as a child. Had it grown after Ms. T took her away?
The woman smiled and raised her wine bottle, inviting her to toast. Daffodill looked at her swaying, carefree manner and felt inexplicably angry.
"I have already lost everything. What exactly am I supposed to toast to?"
"Do toasts need reasons? Well… then… to the despair of having nothing, to skies never witnessed. And to the one and only daffodil in the center of this lake."
"…Do you want to pick that flower too?"
"Mmm… I need that flower. But I will not pick it."
Meeting Daffodill's look that clearly said this was contradictory, the woman tapped her forehead with the wet tip of her umbrella.
"Who decided that needing something means you must take it? I only need it to exist, so I can drink something fine while admiring it like this. That is enough for me."
When the wind rose, she heard a different sound of rustling leaves than before.
Perhaps… there really was a daffodil growing in the center of the lake.
Translation:
Non aveva mai saputo che un narciso crescesse al centro del lago. Non lo aveva mai visto da bambina. Era spuntato dopo che la signorina T l'aveva portata via?
La donna sorrise e sollevò la bottiglia di vino, invitandola a brindare. Daffodill guardò i suoi modi ciondolanti e spensierati e provò un'inspiegabile rabbia.
"Ho già perso tutto. A cosa dovrei brindare esattamente?"
"I brindisi hanno bisogno di motivi? Beh… allora… alla disperazione di non avere nulla, a cieli mai visti. E all'unico, solo narciso al centro di questo lago."
"…Vuoi cogliere anche quel fiore?"
"Mmm… ho bisogno di quel fiore. Ma non lo coglierò."
Incontrando lo sguardo di Daffodill, che esprimeva chiaramente quanto ciò fosse contraddittorio, la donna le diede un colpetto sulla fronte con la punta bagnata del suo ombrello.
"Chi ha stabilito che aver bisogno di qualcosa significhi doversene appropriare? Ho solo bisogno che esista, così posso bere qualcosa di buono ammirandolo in questo modo. Per me è sufficiente."
Quando il vento si levò, udì un fruscio di foglie diverso rispetto a prima.
Forse… c'era davvero un narciso che cresceva al centro del lago.

Source:
They would rest together on Madam T's lap, one on each side.
Before sleep, they would clean each other's wounds from the day's trials or quests, like two small animals grooming one another.
But sometimes she would wonder… was she the same as Zankou? Did not resisting the trials and quests mean she was enjoying them?
No. What she enjoyed was the feeling of being needed, and from that lingering warmth, her thoughts drifted towards parental dependence…
Translation:
Riposavano insieme sulle ginocchia di Madam T, uno per lato.
Prima di dormire, si pulivano a vicenda le ferite riportate nelle prove o missioni del giorno, come due piccoli animali che si toelettano l'un l'altro.
Ma a volte si chiedeva… era uguale a Zankou? Il fatto di non opporre resistenza alle prove e alle missioni significava forse che le piacevano?
No. Ciò che le piaceva era la sensazione di sentirsi necessaria, e da quel calore persistente i suoi pensieri scivolavano verso una dipendenza genitoriale…

Source: She always does things at her own pace, carrying out instructions. I just have her observe how others laugh, make noise, and mess up ordinary little things. These trivial moments are more important to her than any training.
Translation: Fa sempre le cose al proprio ritmo, eseguendo le istruzioni. Le faccio semplicemente osservare come gli altri ridono, fanno baccano e sbagliano nelle piccole cose ordinarie. Questi momenti insignificanti sono più importanti per lei di qualsiasi addestramento.

Source: She pushed the door open and went inside. The rust-red sea climbed up to her feet and dizziness soon followed, like staring into a kaleidoscope.\nAt that moment, a pair of hands wearing red gloves covered her eyes.\nMs. T, who happened to be visiting, witnessed the tragedy of her parents alongside her. In her heartbreak, she offered to adopt Daffodill as her daughter. The beautiful girl had lost both parents, and no other relatives would risk being implicated by taking in a child of misfortune… She had always been the one who was not needed. Only Ms. T reached out her hand to her, so she gratefully took her place by Ms. T's side.
Translation: Spinse la porta ed entrò. Quel mare color ruggine le risalì fino ai piedi e subito fu colta da vertigini, come se stesse guardando attraverso un caleidoscopio.

Namespace: In quell'istante, un paio di mani con guanti rossi le coprì gli occhi.

La signora T, che si trovava lì in visita, assistette insieme a lei alla tragedia dei suoi genitori. Con il cuore a pezzi, si offrò di adottare Daffodill come sua figlia. Quella splendida bambina aveva perso entrambi i genitori e nessun parente avrebbe rischiato di essere coinvolto accogliendo una creatura segnata dalla sfortuna… Era sempre stata quella di cui nessuno aveva bisogno. Solo la signora T le tese la mano, e così lei prese con gratitudine il suo posto al fianco della signora T.

Source: She has a pure soul, like a steady white flame that never burns out even in the midst of blood and violence. We were partners for years, and I never tasted a negative emotion from her. Then one day, standing over an enemy who was pleading, she hesitated. That night, the girl who never spoke about anything came to me for a talk. I thought she was growing weak, and while I was concerned for her change, another part of me wanted her to rely on me more… Then came the betrayal. I'll never forget the storm that day, the look on her face as she escaped, and the color burning in her soul… A color I'd never seen before.
Translation: Possiede un'anima pura, come una salda fiamma bianca che non si spegne mai, neppure in mezzo al sangue e alla violenza. Siamo state compagne per anni, e da lei non ho mai percepito una singola emozione negativa. Poi un giorno, dinanzi a un nemico che implorava pietà, ha esitato. Quella notte, la ragazza che non parlava mai di nulla è venuta da me per confidarsi. Pensavo che si stesse indebolendo e, se da un lato ero preoccupata per il suo cambiamento, dall'altro desideravo che contasse di più su di me… Poi è arrivato il tradimento. Non dimenticherò mai la tempesta di quel giorno, l'espressione sul suo volto mentre fuggiva e il colore che le ardeva nell'anima… Un colore che non avevo mai visto prima.

After completing basic employee training, Chiz's first task at Pink Paws Bank was to get a customer to sign up for a card.
"It's easy," said Mayu, her mentor, patting her on the shoulder. "Our bank has the best benefits in all of Hethereau. You've got this."
"Sorry, I don't need one."
"No thank you."
"Uh-huh, okay, okay, uh-huh, okay, I understand, okay, okay."
Chiz collected dozens of polite refusals and cold shoulders. The air conditioning blasted in the bank lobby; Chiz felt cold inside, too. She huddled in a corner, wondering about resigning. Maybe she wasn't cut out for this job. She was always bad at so many things. She didn't even know how to write a resignation letter.
Chiz would probably remember the day she met Kolinsna forever, with her beautiful golden hair and dazzling red dress. Chiz felt like she was looking at Fons herself walking among mortals. She remembered how Mayu had described it: "Someone who looks like they'd definitely sign up for a card." Chiz really wanted to stay. She just had to try a little harder. So she gathered her courage and walked up. "H-Hello!" she started, "Welcome to Pink Paws Bank… Would you like to sign up for a card?"
The girl with the golden hair and red dress seemed startled by her. She stared at Chiz for a good while, then spoke. Her voice was lovely… until she proceeded to point out Chiz's every flaw; from the way she talked, to her outfit and appearance, to her posture and the angle she was standing at. Chiz felt stares coming from every direction. Tears were already welling up in her eyes. She really wasn't suited for this job after all…
"I'll sign up for a card."
Would Mayu teach her how to write a resignation letter…?
"Hey, don't you even know how to process a card?"
"S-sorry!" Chiz apologized on reflex, then kept responding yes, over and over. Before her brain could catch up, she was already standing in front of the machine. Somehow, despite her fumbling, she managed to successfully issue a card.
"Th-thank you for coming." She didn't know why things had turned out this way, but the result was delightful. After seeing off the young noblewoman, Mayu finally found her chance to approach. She looked at Chiz, who was especially happy about successfully signing up her first customer, with an indescribable expression. "Chiz, do you know who that was?"
"She was… That lady just now?"
"She's the Dvořák family's young lady."
Chiz's smile slowly faded. Pink Paws Bank belonged to the Dvořáks.
Under Mayu's pitying gaze, Chiz choked out: "M-Mayu, do you know how to write a resignation letter?"
Translation: Dopo aver completato la formazione aziendale di base, il primo compito di Chiz alla Banca Pink Paws fu convincere un cliente a richiedere una carta.

Namespace: È un gioco da ragazzi, le disse Mayu, la sua mentore, dandole una pacca sulla spalla. "La nostra banca offre le migliori agevolazioni di tutta Hethereau. Ce la farai senza problemi!"
Uh-huh, d'accordo, va bene, uh-huh, ho capito, certo, certo.

Chiz incassò decine di gentili rifiuti e sguardi di sufficienza. L'aria condizionata ruggiva nell'atrio della banca; anche dentro di sé, Chiz avvertiva un brivido gelido. Si rannicchiò in un angolo, pensando di dimettersi. Forse non era proprio tagliata per quel lavoro. Era sempre stata negata per così tante cose. Non sapeva nemmeno come scrivere una lettera di dimissioni.

Chiz avrebbe probabilmente ricordato per sempre il giorno in cui incontrò Kolinsna: meravigliosi capelli dorati e uno sfolgorante abito rosso. A Chiz sembrò di vedere Fons in persona camminare tra i comuni mortali. Le tornò in mente la descrizione di Mayu: "Qualcuno con l'aria di chi farebbe sicuramente una carta". Chiz desiderava davvero restare. Doveva solo provarci con un pizzico di impegno in più. Raccolse tutto il suo coraggio e le si avvicinò. "S-salve!", esordì, "Benvenuta alla Banca Pink Paws… Le andrebbe di sottoscrivere una carta?"

La ragazza dai capelli d'oro e dall'abito rosso parve sorpresa. Fissò Chiz per un bel po', poi prese la parola. La sua voce era incantevole… finché non cominciò a evidenziare ogni singolo difetto di Chiz: da come parlava, ai suoi abiti e al suo aspetto, fino alla postura e all'angolazione con cui stava in piedi. Chiz si sentì osservata da ogni direzione. Gli occhi le si stavano già riempiendo di lacrime. In fondo non era proprio adatta a quel lavoro…
Mayu le avrebbe mai insegnato come scrivere una lettera di dimissioni…?
Ehi, non sai nemmeno come si emette una carta?

M-mi scusi!, balbettò Chiz per riflesso incondizionato, per poi continuare ad annuire all'infinito. Prima ancora che il suo cervello potesse elaborare la situazione, si ritrovò davanti al terminale. In qualche modo, nonostante le sue goffe esitazioni, riuscì a emettere la carta con successo.

G-grazie per essere venuta!. Non capiva come le cose fossero arrivate a quel punto, ma il risultato era strepitoso. Dopo aver congedato la giovane nobildonna, Mayu trovò finalmente il modo di avvicinarsi. Guardò Chiz, particolarmente raggiante per aver registrato il suo primo cliente, con un'espressione indecifrabile. "Chiz, sai chi era quella?"
È la giovane erede della famiglia Dvořák.
Il sorriso di Chiz svanì all'istante. La Banca Pink Paws apparteneva ai Dvořák.
Sotto lo sguardo compassionevole di Mayu, Chiz riuscì solo a balbettare: "M-Mayu, sai per caso come si scrive una lettera di dimissioni?"

For most people, dreams are unstable and ephemeral. Iroi's Esper Ability stabalizes dreams, making them constants that do not cease to exist when impacted by external factors.
Iroi can send her dreams into the consciousness of other living beings. The number of beings she can affect at the same time varies, depending on the targets' mental strengths. If the target's mental strength is too high, she may not be able to break in at all. She also can't affect beings without sentience.

Two gates exist at the entrance of Iroi's dream world, a Horned Gate and an Ivory Gate. Sometimes she conceals one of them when necessary.
If one enters the Ivory Gate, they are forced to experience a long and bizarre dream of creatures fighting and devouring each other. No one knows why this is the case.
If one enters the Horned Gate, they reach Iroi's true dream world and can have a nice dream. The real Iroi is hiding somewhere in the corner of this world.

In other words, the "Iroi" people see on the outside is not her true self.
The Iroi people see is nothing but an illusion created by her powers. The external Iroi, after taking over the original, is in essence a non-human consciousness that mimics human beings.
Don't be afraid. The external Iroi has posed as a human for about twenty years. She's not that different from a genuine human. She won't bite.
No need to panic.
Translation:
Per la maggior parte delle persone, i sogni sono instabili ed effimeri. L'Abilità Esper di Iroi stabilizza i sogni, rendendoli costanti che non cessano di esistere quando vengono influenzati da fattori esterni.
Iroi può inviare i suoi sogni nella coscienza di altri esseri viventi. Il numero di esseri che può influenzare contemporaneamente varia, a seconda della forza mentale dei bersagli. Se la forza mentale del bersaglio è troppo alta, potrebbe non riuscire affatto a penetrare. Inoltre non può influenzare esseri privi di coscienza.

All'ingresso del mondo onirico di Iroi esistono due porte, una Porta Cornuta e una Porta d'Avorio. A volte ne nasconde una quando necessario.
Se si entra dalla Porta d'Avorio, si è costretti a vivere un lungo e bizzarro sogno di creature che combattono e si divorano a vicenda. Nessuno sa il perché.
Se si entra dalla Porta Cornuta, si raggiunge il vero mondo onirico di Iroi e si può fare un bel sogno. La vera Iroi si nasconde da qualche parte in un angolo di questo mondo.

In altre parole, la "Iroi" che la gente vede all'esterno non è il suo vero sé.
La Iroi che la gente vede non è altro che un'illusione creata dai suoi poteri. La Iroi esterna, dopo aver preso il posto dell'originale, è in sostanza una coscienza non umana che imita gli esseri umani.
Non abbiate paura. La Iroi esterna si è spacciata per umana per circa vent'anni. Non è poi così diversa da un vero essere umano. Non morde.
Nessun motivo di panico.

Source:
When it comes to the unknown, human beings have always shared the same curiosity and arrogance. From awe to fear, from scrutinizing to touching, until the spark of "conquest" fully ignited the fuse of greed… such was the attitude some held toward the existence known as "Espers".
Cults, circles, private research institutes, secret societies… those driven by greed and pride gathered like hyenas, desperate for a morsel of flesh. They would pay any price, ignore every restriction and taboo, and thirst for the miracles an Esper Ability could bring… or perhaps, for the ability itself.
On a remote island, there was a secret society deemed "Eyepecker." Its members believed in a heresy: Esper Abilities were a gift from a mysterious unknown, and that gift would bless the fortunate ones born with special "eyes". They went about collecting those who were described as such, regarding them as "vessels" for the awakening of Esper Abilities, imprisoning them in dark, dank dungeons and burning their eyes every day with a searing mixture. They firmly believed this would awaken abilities—and that by transplanting those eyes into themselves, they could seize that power for their own.
Zankou's earliest memory began in that cruel jail.
The girl had a pair of gem-like eyes. She could not understand why, her vision deprived of color, she could only see a gray-white blur. What she understood even less was how far a human's greed could push them to do the unspeakable. Ever since Eyepecker had abducted her, the meaning of her existence had been reduced to being completely bound every day, having her eyelids pried open, and trembling as the scalding, acrid, murky liquid dripped onto her eyeballs.
The voracious, intoxicated by their own delusions, carried out their devilish deeds day after day, heedless of its absurdity. Yet, ironically, Zankou really did awaken the Esper Ability dwelling in her eyes under that inhuman torture. When she was brought to the eye-extraction ritual, the society's members were already arguing over who the eyes would belong to, each one revealing the hidden identity they had been concealing all along: the powerful, the wealthy, or some illustrious family… Their voices grew into a raucous uproar, and in the haze of anesthesia, Zankou saw the first color beyond black and white. It was warm and blinding, burning brightly among the embers of countless souls, spraying from wounds opened in slaughter, weaving into a scarlet maelstrom that encircled her…
That day, the Eye of Delusion shrouded the entire island, and the lowlifes who competed with one another instead butchered each other to death, drowning within the hallucination, until no one was left alive.
Translation: Di fronte all'ignoto, gli esseri umani hanno sempre condiviso la medesima curiosità e arroganza. Dal timore reverenziale alla paura, dall'esaminare al toccare, fino a quando la scintilla della "conquista" non ha innescato completamente la miccia dell'avidità... Questo era l'atteggiamento che alcuni nutrivano verso l'esistenza nota come "Esper".

For Shinku, the challenge of transferring to CSU-2 was more about getting along with the two new teammates than about getting used to a new place.
Mint. A one-of-a-kind character who somehow invalidates Shinku's tricks to keep her distance. Whether Shinku puts on a resting drake face or makes up an excuse, Mint just brushes it off and keeps approaching her. "Resting drake face? Aww, why so grumpy, who made Taya angry this time? Or did you fail an exam?" "Busy? Sure, let's do it another time then! How about after work tomorrow?"
Mint does not know when to back off. She's just there because she wants to be. It's a hassle, really… but Shinku doesn't hate it—who hates a friendly kitty anyway?
As for the other teammate…
Oneiroi. After Shinku's first mission with her, she understood exactly why she'd been transferred to Unit 2. This one had the ability to prevent her from going berserk. This should have been good news for Shinku, because she'd finally stop worrying about hurting teammates. But she couldn't bring herself to accept Oneiroi the way she accepted Mint.
Iroi was hiding herself. She wasn't showing her true self…
And that was what Shinku was exactly doing.
Translation:
Per Shinku, la sfida del trasferimento alla CSU-2 riguardava più l'andare d'accordo con le due nuove compagne di squadra che l'abituarsi a un nuovo posto.
Mint. Un personaggio unico nel suo genere che in qualche modo vanifica i trucchi di Shinku per mantenere le distanze. Che Shinku assuma un'espressione imbronciata o inventi una scusa, Mint lascia semplicemente correre e continua ad avvicinarsi. "Faccia da drago imbronciato? Ooh, perché così scontrosa, chi ha fatto arrabbiare Taya stavolta? O hai fallito un esame?" "Occupata? Certo, facciamolo un'altra volta allora! Che ne dici di domani dopo il lavoro?"
Mint non sa cosa significhi tirarsi indietro. È lì semplicemente perché vuole esserci. È una seccatura, davvero… ma Shinku non la odia; d'altronde, chi potrebbe mai odiare una gattina amichevole?
Quanto all'altra compagna di squadra…
Oneiroi. Dopo la prima missione di Shinku con lei, ha capito esattamente perché era stata trasferita all'Unità 2. Lei aveva la capacità di impedirle di perdere il controllo. Questa avrebbe dovuto essere una buona notizia per Shinku, perché avrebbe finalmente smesso di preoccuparsi di fare del male ai compagni. Ma non riusciva ad accettare Oneiroi nello stesso modo in cui aveva accettato Mint.
Iroi stava nascondendo se stessa. Non mostrava il suo vero io…
Ed era esattamente ciò che stava facendo Shinku.

Source:
Chiz is terrified of loud noises. She's been afraid of thunder since she was little, but it got so much worse after she became an Esper. This is the price she pays for her powers. The sound of popcorn machines, fireworks going off, even karaoke—any overly-noisy environment makes her heart race. Only her soundproof home soothes her. Because of this, Chiz never attends gatherings.
"Chiz, want to grab dinner together this weekend?"
Mayu was inviting her again. Chiz did want to go. She was so grateful to Mayu, the first person to show her kindness after she joined Pink Paws Bank. And it wasn't just Mayu; there was Haruna, Grace… All her coworkers were wonderful people. Chiz had always wanted to treat them to a meal and properly express her thanks. But someone like her…
"I should probably…"
"How about coming to my place? I'll show you my cooking. Come on, Chiz, come on."
If it was at someone's home, it probably wouldn't be too loud…
Chiz finally accepted. She stayed up all night reading posts on Bagel to learn how to be a polite houseguest. If she never got another chance, she had to make this one count.
"Welcome! You didn't have to bring anything!"
"Chiz's here? Come in, come in!"
"Um… H-Hello, everyone…"
The house was warm. There was the smell of home cooking and the chatter of coworkers. So this is what a gathering was like. How nice. Just as Chiz was secretly feeling happy, Grace handed her a box.
"F-for me?"
"Of course! Open it, quick." Haruna leaned in close to Chiz, urging her to open it.
Chiz untied the ribbon. Inside the box was a pair of noise-canceling earplugs. They were beautiful. And pink.
"Pretty, right? We all picked them out together."
"Other than being cute, they're almost completely useless. The noise-canceling is extremely average."
"But they're perfect for our Chiz, right?"
Yes, the noise-canceling was perfectly average… Just enough for Chiz to hear the sound of fireworks blooming in the sky without being so scared that she had to cover her ears and run away.
Translation:
Chiz è terrorizzata dai rumori forti. Ha paura dei tuoni fin da piccola, ma la situazione è peggiorata molto dopo che è diventata un'Esper. Questo è il prezzo che paga per i suoi poteri. Il suono delle macchine per i popcorn, i fuochi d'artificio, persino il karaoke... qualsiasi ambiente troppo rumoroso le fa battere forte il cuore. Solo la sua casa insonorizzata la calma. Per questo motivo, Chiz non partecipa mai alle riunioni.
"Chiz, vuoi che andiamo a cena insieme questo fine settimana?"
Mayu la stava invitando di nuovo. Chiz voleva davvero andare. Era così grata a Mayu, la prima persona a mostrarle gentilezza dopo essersi unita alla Banca Paws Rosa. E non c'era solo Mayu; c'erano Haruna, Grace... Tutti i suoi colleghi erano persone meravigliose. Chiz aveva sempre desiderato offrire loro una cena e ringraziarli adeguatamente. Ma una come lei...
"Probabilmente dovrei..."
"Che ne dici di venire da me? Ti mostrerò come cucino. Dai, Chiz, dai."
Se fosse stato a casa di qualcuno, probabilmente non sarebbe stato troppo rumoroso...
Alla fine Chiz accettò. Rimase sveglia tutta la notte a leggere post su Bagel per imparare a essere un'ospite educata. Se non avesse mai avuto un'altra possibilità, doveva far fruttare questa.
"Benvenuta! Non dovevi portare nulla!"
"Chiz è qui? Entra, entra!"
"Ehm... C-Ciao a tutti..."
La casa era calda. C'era profumo di cucina casalinga e il chiacchiericcio dei colleghi. Quindi ecco com'era un ritrovo. Che bello. Proprio mentre Chiz si sentiva segretamente felice, Grace le porse una scatola.
"P-per me?"
"Certo! Aprila, presto." Haruna si chinò vicino a Chiz, esortandola ad aprirla.
Chiz slegò il nastro. Dentro la scatola c'era un paio di tappi per le orecchie con cancellazione del rumore. Erano bellissimi. E rosa.
"Belli, vero? Li abbiamo scelti tutti insieme."
"Oltre ad essere carini, sono quasi completamente inutili. La cancellazione del rumore è molto mediocre."
"Ma sono perfetti per la nostra Chiz, vero?"
Sì, la cancellazione del rumore era perfettamente mediocre... Abbastanza perché Chiz sentisse il suono dei fuochi d'artificio che sbocciavano nel cielo senza essere così spaventata da doversi coprire le orecchie e scappare.

Source:
Chiz keeps a diary. She hasn't stopped writing since receiving her first journal. She writes down everything worth remembering, so that when she sees her family again someday, she can tell them everything. Then, she'll finally say the words she's been preparing for so long: "Yes, I've been doing well out here."
But her diary isn't just words: there are rice ball wrapper labels, flower petals that landed on her shoulder, and stickers from coworkers. They're all proof that she's doing well. Chiz feels that only by recording things this way can she truly feel like she's not just stumbling through a pleasant dream.
At first, Chiz's diary entries were very short.
"M: XX, D: XX. Food was good."
"M: XX, D: XX. Clothes were pretty."
"M: XX, D: XX. Flowers smelled nice."
She didn't know what else to write, so she just honestly recorded how she felt. Once, a friend found out and suggested, "If you don't know what to write, why not try drawing?" But Chiz didn't think her drawings were all that good, either. She was still troubled.
One day, Chiz ate a delicious candy. She couldn't bear to throw away even the crinkled wrapper, so she put it in her diary. The candy was delicious, and her problem was solved. She's continued to this day.
"Ahhh, how is it this late already? I have work tomorrow!"
Chiz hurriedly closes her diary. Her entries have been longer and longer, lately. There's more and more worth recording. That tasty milk tea has to be written down. Getting praised by her manager has to be written down. The first sunny day of spring, the first sunny day of summer, the first sunny day of fall, and the first snowfall of winter all have to be properly recorded. Chiz doesn't like rainy days. She only likes sunny days, because on rainy days, food is hard to find.
But Chiz really likes snowy days in Hethereau. Snow is clean and white.
Translation:
Chiz tiene un diario. Non ha più smesso di scrivere da quando ha ricevuto il suo primo taccuino. Annota tutto ciò che vale la pena ricordare, così che, quando un giorno rivedrà la sua famiglia, potrà raccontare loro ogni cosa. Allora potrà finalmente pronunciare quelle parole che prepara da così tanto tempo: "Sì, me la sono cavata bene qui fuori."
Ma il suo diario non è fatto solo di parole: ci sono etichette degli incarti degli onigiri, petali di fiori atterrati sulla sua spalla e adesivi dei colleghi. Sono tutte prove che sta bene. Chiz sente che solo registrando le cose in questo modo può davvero sentire di non stare semplicemente barcollando dentro a un bel sogno.
All'inizio, le pagine del diario di Chiz erano molto brevi.
"M: XX, G: XX. Il cibo era buono."
"M: XX, G: XX. I vestiti erano carini."
"M: XX, G: XX. I fiori profumavano."
Non sapeva cos'altro scrivere, così si limitava ad annotare sinceramente come si sentiva. Una volta un'amica lo scoprì e le suggerì: "Se non sai cosa scrivere, perché non provi a disegnare?". Ma Chiz non pensava che i suoi disegni fossero granché, neanche quelli. Era ancora in difficoltà.
Un giorno, Chiz mangiò una caramella deliziosa. Non ebbe il cuore di buttare via nemmeno l'incarto stropicciato, così lo incollò nel diario. La caramella era squisita e il suo problema fu risolto. Ha continuato così fino a oggi.
"Aahh, com'è possibile che sia già così tardi? Domani lavoro!"
Chiz chiude in fretta il diario. Le sue annotazioni sono state sempre più lunghe, ultimamente. C'è sempre più roba che vale la pena ricordare. Quel delizioso tè al latte dev'essere annotato. I complimenti del responsabile devono essere annotati. La prima giornata di sole in primavera, la prima giornata di sole in estate, la prima giornata di sole in autunno e la prima nevicata d'inverno devono essere tutte registrate a dovere. A Chiz non piacciono i giorni di pioggia. Le piacciono solo i giorni di sole, perché quando piove è difficile trovare cibo.
Ma a Chiz piacciono tantissimo i giorni di neve a Hethereau. La neve è pulita e bianca.

Source:
Chiz stands, professionally dressed, in the gleaming lobby of a bank.
Chiz walks the corners where the streetlights don't reach, sewage pooling under the cracks in the pavement.
"Chiz, Chiz, where are you going?"

Once Chiz learned to run without stumbling, she had to leave home and help her older siblings find food outside. Shiny bread wrapped in plastic… Chiz only saw that once. Most of the time, all she could find were wild vegetables and mushrooms. When even those were gone, they had no choice but to hunt "Apocha." That's what they called the edible Anomalies. But Apocha were dangerous; it was common to get hurt, and medicine was even harder to find than food. And then there was that saying: "Eat too many Apocha, and you'll become an Esper." Espers, like Anomalies, were outsiders to be driven away; because, just like Anomalies, Espers attack. After dinner, Chiz watched her mother cradle her newborn baby sister; patting her, soothing her, singing to her. Chiz remembered when she was little, so little that the whole world was no bigger than her mother's embrace, her mother would gently pat her, soothe her, and sing to her.
"Chiz, Chiz, grow up quick."

Faster, faster. Chiz pressed her palm against the bleeding wound on her neck, glancing back at the Apocha that was closely tailing her. She ran as hard as she could, away from home. Farther, farther—until she couldn't run anymore. Chiz tripped on a rock and fell hard to the ground. The Apocha had vanished somewhere along the way. She didn't have the strength to stand, so she just lay there, nibbling at the food she'd found. She could only eat a little. She had to bring the rest home. Her family was waiting for her. She had to get home… Chiz couldn't remember how she found her way back. But somehow, she made it home with the food… and a new Ability. Maybe, just like the stories said, she had eaten too many Apocha. On her last night home, she used her new Esper Ability to put on a little fireworks show for her younger siblings. She remembered their eyes shining bright, their soft gasps; fighting over who got to play with their magical big sister.
The next day, her mother brought Chiz to the shore. A boat would take her away from home, carry her to a new world. Even after her mother's silhouette had completely disappeared from sight, Chiz could still hear someone calling out in the salty sea breeze.
"Chiz, Chiz, you must…"

Chiz now lives in the heart of Hethereau. Even at night, the whole New Herland District blazes with lights. Chiz often turns off all her lights indoors and leans against the window, watching the flow of cars outside. Back in her homeland, nights were deathly silent. Light didn't mean streetlamps or the moon; light meant danger. It could be an Anomaly's lure. It could be dangerous Espers and their weapons.
Chiz sits in the darkness of her room, while a glittering world sparkles outside her window. She hugs herself, imitating her mother from memory, softly humming a melody still warm with feeling.
"Chiz, Chiz, you must be happy."

Just like most people can't remember their earliest days as an infant, Lacrimosa can't recall anything from before she became "Lacrimosa."
Based on a line of text carved on the coffin where she woke up, Lacrimosa decided on her own name. Why don't other people get to decide their own? Don't adults always tell her that she should choose the kind of person she wants to become?
However, names she didn't choose like "Mosa" or "Lacrimosa Senpai" also seem to be calling her. If she had chosen a different name, would she have become a different person? …Lacrimosa can't answer such complex questions yet.
She only knows that her teammates taught her to respond seriously when her name is called. Lacrimosa has kept those words close to her heart.
"That super-strong pretty girl from ETD may always have a blank expression, but she's surprisingly down-to-earth! When I greeted her on the street last time, she even responded! Oh my gosh, so cute!"

Proprio come la maggior parte delle persone non ricorda i suoi primi giorni da neonata, Lacrimosa non riesce a ricordare nulla di prima di diventare "Lacrimosa".

Tuttavia, anche nomi che non ha scelto, come "Mosa" o "Lacrimosa Senpai", sembrano chiamarla. Se avesse scelto un nome diverso, sarebbe diventata una persona diversa? …Lacrimosa non è ancora in grado di rispondere a domande così complesse.
Sa solo che i suoi compagni di squadra le hanno insegnato a rispondere seriamente quando viene chiamata per nome. Lacrimosa ha custodito quelle parole nel profondo del cuore.

There was an Esper who went by the name of Icaria on the Boulder. She was short and had a pair of wings, which saved her when the smuggler's ship sank. She usually enjoys zipping around, often joking that she never grew taller because her feet never touched the ground. Conrak called her "Shorty."
Icaria didn't have any parents. She just had an older brother, who liked to make a big deal about working hard to raise her. The brother, however, never cared about her. That's why Icaria decided to stay on the island, though she was capable of flying home herself.
Icaria died when the crew fought an anomaly known as the Kraken. Her wings were not made from feathers, but from some material that melted in high heat. During the fight, she tried to make the anomaly focus on her, but her wings melted when she flew too high and fell right into the Kraken.

After that, Conrak was frustrated about the limitations of his abilities. He tried to experiment with what kind of shapes his smoke could form. Just before a battle, a bird flew past him. He thought that if he could shape his smoke into a bird, he could take to the sky.
This idea didn't come at a good time: he couldn't apply it to the battle at hand, but it was enough to make him regretful… If only he had thought of it sooner, he could have saved Icaria.
Nonetheless, the idea wouldn't have helped even if he had it earlier. 

Chaos is still trying to create flying birds with his smoke. Even after years of practice, he is still only able to create a few small birds that could fly a few meters, unable to even carry the tiniest speck of dust.
Translation: C'era un Esper di nome Icaria sul Boulder. Era bassa e aveva un paio d'ali, che la salvarono quando la nave del contrabbandiere affondò. Di solito le piaceva sfrecciare in giro, scherzando spesso sul fatto di non essere cresciuta in altezza perché i suoi piedi non toccavano mai terra. Conrak la chiamava "Tappetto".

The year-end shopping list was, as always, Jiuyuan's responsibility. But this year, when it came to what to buy, things were a little different from before. The moment Haniel and Illica, who had just recently joined, heard about the year-end shopping, they immediately insisted on adding a celebration party that wasn't part of the original plan. And so, what was once a neat and simple list turned into an outing for all five of them.
"Jiuyuan! We need flowers, balloons, spotlights… and cake!"
"And a standee!"
"…What's a standee?"
"You know, one of those poster things with your photo on it that you put by the entrance. Hathor, wanna try it?"
"That won't be necessary… Master."

"What about presents? There should at least be presents!"
"Of course, everyone gets one."
"Hehe, Jiuyuan's the best!"
"What about Jenson? Did he get us presents?"
"Today's bill is going under his name."
"Jenson's so generous!"
"Then I'm adding a few new comics!"
"And the CD I didn't get last time!"
"…Fine, get it all."

The list was checked, revised, and added to over and over again.
As the two little owlets eagerly confirmed every checkmark with Jenson, Jiuyuan stood off to the side and let out a soft sigh.
A little noisy, a little chaotic.
But in moments like these, the accounts can wait, and the plans can be pushed back a bit.
Times like this… aren't so bad.
Translation: La lista della spesa di fine anno era, come sempre, responsabilità di Jiuyuan. Ma quest'anno, per quanto riguardava cosa comprare, le cose stavano andando in modo un po' diverso dal solito. Non appena Haniel e Illica, entrate da poco, hanno sentito parlare della spesa di fine anno, hanno subito insistito per aggiungere una festa di celebrazione che non faceva parte del piano originale. E così, quella che un tempo era una lista semplice e ordinata si è trasformata in un'uscita per tutti e cinque.

As a pardoned prisoner, she isn't treated any differently than any other Squad 4 member.
Except by that dog-faced guy with calm but wary eyes. Maybe because a few months ago they were escort officer and wanted criminal?
Well, overall, she thinks her new job is pretty good. Fighting to her heart's content, letting danger excite her mind, letting pain make her body tremble… violence comes from life's excess. How could anyone not be addicted to tasting it?
She doesn't know why that strange woman brought her back from the island, but whatever. She had nowhere else to go anyway. The place where she once knelt and prayed devoutly, entrusting her faith, has long been sealed off. Anyone who sees that ruined wasteland would laugh! Only a pair of familiar silver eyes still gaze at her, merciful, generous, full of desire… she can feel it.

"Go raise some hell, Fadia. I'm sure you'll find something interesting."
A pretender, a dog, and a brat?
Fadia narrowed her eyes.
Well then… let's find that "something interesting."
Translation:
Uno dei membri della ETD-4 dell'Ufficio Controllo Anomalie, e un tempo criminale.
Quanto al crimine per cui è stata sbattuta sulla leggendaria Isola di Ghroth… nulla di troppo grave. Solo un piccolo gesto innocente che ha fatto addormentare per sempre alcune persone.
"La rinascita e la reincarnazione senza fine riconducono tutte al buco nero del nulla."
Attorcigliandosi i capelli attorno al dito, sorrise con gli occhi scintillanti.
"Ho semplicemente esaudito i loro desideri, inviando quei festaioli nel paradiso che bramavano da tutta la vita."

In quanto prigioniera graziata, non viene trattata diversamente da qualsiasi altro membro della Squadra 4.
Tranne che da quel tipo con la faccia da cane e dagli occhi calmi ma diffidenti. Forse perché solo pochi mesi fa erano ufficiale di scorta e ricercata criminale?
Beh, nel complesso, pensa che il suo nuovo lavoro sia fantastico. Combattere a perdifiato, lasciare che il pericolo le ecciti la mente, lasciare che il dolore le faccia tremare il corpo… la violenza nasce dall'eccesso della vita. Come potrebbe chiunque non esserne assuefatto?
Non sa perché quella donna misteriosa l'abbia riportata indietro dall'isola, ma poco importa. In ogni caso non aveva nessun altro posto dove andare. Il luogo in cui un tempo si inginocchiava e pregava devotamente, affidando la propria fede, è stato sigillato da tempo. Chiunque vedesse quella landa desolata scoppierebbe a ridere! Solo un paio di familiari occhi d'argento continuano a fissarla, misericordiosi, generosi, pieni di desiderio… riesce a percepirlo.

"Va' a scatenare l'inferno, Fadia. Sono sicura che troverai qualcosa di interessante."
Un impostore, un cane e una mocciosa?
Fadia socchiuse gli occhi.
E va bene, allora… troviamo questo "qualcosa di interessante".

Source:
Captain of ETD-4 at the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Baicang—carefree, irreverant, blunt to a fault, master of dodging work, and a walking troublemaker.
In a certain hidden internal Bagel forum in the Bureau, a heated discussion unfolds: "Who's the least captain-like captain among ETD?"
"Am I the only one who thinks Captain Baicang from Squad 4 has a twisted sense of humor???"
"You're not alone. Every night, before I fall alseep, I realize the pranks he pulled on me at work. You have no idea how much that disrupts my sleep."
"Same here. And when you confront him about it, he just gives you this smiling face… ugh, makes me want to clench my fists even tighter."
…
It's actually pretty funny.
With zero remorse for his antics, Baicang swoops in to gleefully like and save every comment.

Rumors about Squad 4's captain are mixed.
For instance, "Watch out for that long silver-white braid, for it's the Reaper's banner." "He seems to like hiding behind his team members and playing weak, but he's actually analyzing his opponents' strength and countermeasures." "He's reliable when it counts, very capable, and doesn't abuse his power." "He loves all kinds of pasta, especially Italian, but when he cooks it himself he breaks the noodles in half before putting them in the pot (absolutely tasteless)." All these rumors are basically true, confirmed with love from his closest team members.

Beyond that, things lurk in his past that they cannot see.

From an unwanted branch family child to voluntarily entering the main house for Esper Ability development, the young man gradually slipped toward what he thought was a beautiful "abyss." He learned early the weight of life: Light as a feather. Something he could blow away just by speaking. For a long time he stopped saying anything at all, perhaps to atone, perhaps simply from fear. He was like a lone young leaf that had lost its way, spinning as it fell, until finally caught by someone important… that was when he found his home.

Are words curses or prayers? He can easily extinguish life, yet cannot preserve anything. Thus, he can only keep moving forward.
From summer to winter, from spring to fall, the veins of fall leaves turn yellow, still clinging to the branches before finally falling.
In the system of the Five Colors, white is associated with Gui Cang and the season of autumn, giving rise to the name White Cang or Baicang.
Translation:
Capitano della ETD-4 presso l'Ufficio Anomalie. Baicang: spensierato, irriverente, schietto fino all'eccesso, maestro nello scansare il lavoro e piantagrane ambulante.
In un certo forum interno nascosto di Bagel nell'Ufficio, si scatena un'accesa discussione: "Chi è il capitano meno simile a un capitano tra le ETD?"
"Sono l'unico a pensare che il Capitano Baicang della Squadra 4 abbia un senso dell'umorismo distorto???"
"Non sei il solo. Ogni notte, prima di addormentarmi, mi rendo conto degli scherzi che mi ha fatto al lavoro. Non hai idea di quanto questo rovini il mio sonno."
"Idem qui. E quando lo affronti a riguardo, ti fa semplicemente quel sorriso… ugh, mi fa venire voglia di stringere i pugni ancora più forte."
…
In realtà è piuttosto divertente.
Senza il minimo rimorso per le sue bravate, Baicang si fionda a mettere mi piace con gioia e a salvare ogni commento.

Le voci sul capitano della Squadra 4 sono contrastanti.
Per esempio: "Attenti a quella lunga treccia bianco-argentea, poiché è lo stendardo del Mietitore." "Sembra che gli piaccia nascondersi dietro i membri della sua squadra e fingersi debole, ma in realtà sta analizzando la forza e le contromisure dei suoi avversari." "È affidabile quando conta, molto capace e non abusa del suo potere." "Ama tutti i tipi di pasta, specialmente quella italiana, ma quando la cucina lui spezza gli spaghetti a metà prima di metterli nella pentola (un sacrilegio assoluto)." Tutte queste voci sono fondamentalmente vere, confermate con affetto dai membri a lui più vicini nella squadra.

Oltre a ciò, nel suo passato si celano cose che loro non possono vedere.

Da figlio indesiderato di un ramo cadetto a entrare volontariamente nella casata principale per lo sviluppo dell'Abilità Esper, il giovane scivolò gradualmente verso quello che riteneva un bellissimo "abisso". Imparò presto il peso della vita: leggera come una piuma. Qualcosa che poteva spazzare via semplicemente parlando. Per molto tempo smise di dire qualsiasi cosa, forse per espiare, forse semplicemente per paura. Era come una giovane foglia solitaria che aveva smarrito la via, volteggiando mentre cadeva, finché non fu finalmente afferrata da qualcuno di importante… fu allora che trovò la sua casa.

Le parole sono maledizioni o preghiere? Può estinguere facilmente la vita, eppure non può preservare nulla. Perciò, non può fare altro che continuare ad andare avanti.
Dall'estate all'inverno, dalla primavera all'autunno, le venature delle foglie autunnali ingialliscono, restando ancora aggrappate ai rami prima di cadere definitivamente.
Nel sistema dei Cinque Colori, il bianco è associato a Gui Cang e alla stagione dell'autunno, dando origine al nome Cang Bianco, ossia Baicang.

The Bureau of Anomaly Control and the charity house have entirely different vibes. Still, Iroi was able to get used to the different pace, and she got along with her new teammates, Mint and Shinku.
While Shinku's powers could drive her berserk, Iroi can use her powers to calm Shinku down in the dream world. As a result, Shinku frequently enters Iroi's dream world, and they got along.
However, after a certain mission, things changed. Shinku's attitude towards Iroi shifted for the worse, almost harboring animosity. Iroi didn't know what caused this change, but she responded with the same attitude. The two of them were friendly no more.
Mint noticed the awkward tension between the two. After some poking around between missions, she finally figured it out. Shinku had seen "the other Iroi" in her dream world. Shinku mistakenly assumed that the external Iroi had taken over the real one, and disgusted by what she thought was happening, she held a grudge against the external Iroi.
After that, Mint worked hard to convince Shinku and Iroi to clear up the misunderstanding. Once Shinku learned the truth about the Iroi in the dream world, she realized she assumed wrongly and apologized to Iroi.

"You saw that pitiful being in a dream and threw out everything to stand up for her—what a hotheaded dragon who doesn't think things through!"
"Arrgh, why are you still so mean after I said sorry? You… Ramtenna!"
"Okie-dokie, problem solved! Let's get along with each other like this!"

That's how Mint earned a lavish meal from Shinku and Iroi.
Translation:
L'Ufficio Anomalie e la casa di carità hanno atmosfere completamente differenti. Tuttavia, Iroi riuscì ad abituarsi al diverso ritmo, e andava d'accordo con le sue nuove compagne di squadra, Mint e Shinku.
Mentre i poteri di Shinku potevano farla andare su tutte le furie, Iroi poteva usare i propri per calmarla nel mondo dei sogni. Di conseguenza, Shinku entrava spesso nel mondo dei sogni di Iroi, e le due andavano d'accordo.
Tuttavia, dopo una certa missione, le cose cambiarono. L'atteggiamento di Shinku verso Iroi peggiorò nettamente, covando quasi dell'animosità. Iroi non sapeva cosa avesse causato questo cambiamento, ma rispose con il medesimo atteggiamento. Le due non erano più amichevoli tra loro.
Mint notò l'imbarazzante tensione tra le due. Dopo aver indagato un po' tra una missione e l'altra, alla fine comprese la situazione. Shinku aveva visto "l'altra Iroi" nel suo mondo dei sogni. Shinku aveva erroneamente supposto che l'Iroi esteriore avesse preso il sopravvento su quella vera e, disgustata da ciò che credeva stesse accadendo, nutriva rancore verso l'Iroi esteriore.
Dopodiché, Mint si adoperò per convincere Shinku e Iroi a chiarire il malinteso. Una volta scoperta la verità sull'Iroi nel mondo dei sogni, Shinku si rese conto di aver giudicato male e si scusò con Iroi.

"Hai visto quell'essere pietoso in un sogno e hai gettato al vento ogni cosa per difenderla… che drago impulsivo che non pensa prima di agire!"
"Argh, perché sei ancora così acida dopo che ti ho chiesto scusa? Tu… Ramtenna!"
"Oki-doki, problema risolto! Andiamo d'accordo così d'ora in poi!"

Fu così che Mint si guadagnò un banchetto sontuoso offerto da Shinku e Iroi.

After a busy day, Hathor returned to Sterry. The chatter and cheer inside was somewhat inviting. The Mentor warmly introduced two new members of Sterry: Haniel and Illica. Hathor didn't have any particular thoughts about their arrival and simply nodded in acknowledgment. Following the Mentor's arrangements was something she was used to. If Hathor were to recall her feelings from meeting with Haniel and Illica, she'd probably say: Very energetic, great couriers.

However, while interacting with them over the following few days, Hathor gradually realized that the relationships between the five of them weren't as smooth as expected. The Mentor and Jenson, who were familiar with her, could sense her true thoughts from her expressions and actions even when she said nothing, and knew she wasn't intentionally cold. The two new members didn't seem to understand, though. Perhaps due to her icy exterior, they always showed some instinctive wariness, completely different from how lively they were when facing the Mentor. Just as Hathor was repeatedly pondering how to explain to them that she simply wasn't good at socializing, a conversation with the Mentor changed everything. She was given a unique commission: spend time with Haniel and Illica, and understand the lives of modern youngsters. This was a task with a clear directive, so she didn't hesitate.

However, when actually facing the two, taking the initiative to speak proved much more difficult than expected. Hathor had mentally rehearsed scenarios for initial conversations many times and had even prepared several backup plans for dealing with awkward silences. So, during a rare chat session, she tentatively asked about their daily hobbies. The following responses completely deviated from her expectations:
"Of course it's watching the greatest manga of this century, 'Gen Z'!"
"Buying merch, going to events, analyzing the lore with fellow fans on Bagel, conventions, live events, and wotagei!"
"Seasonal anime previews, fan arts, weekly new episodes… we never miss a single one!"
Faced with Haniel's enthusiastic string of recommendations, Hathor showed visible confusion: What is wotagei? What is an "anime"?
Just as Hathor was about to interrupt and give her brain some time to process, she caught sight of Illica, who was eagerly waiting with excitement to join the conversation. She fell silent for a moment and held herself back from speaking. If they'd really like to talk about it… then listening for a while longer wouldn't hurt.
Translation: Dopo un'intensa giornata di lavoro, Hathor tornò alla Sterry. Il chiacchiericcio e l'allegria all'interno erano alquanto accoglienti. Il Mentore presentò calorosamente due nuovi membri della Sterry: Haniel e Illica. Hathor non si fece pensieri particolari sul loro arrivo e si limitò a un cenno di saluto con il capo. Seguire le disposizioni del Mentore era qualcosa a cui era abituata. Se a Hathor fosse stato chiesto di rievocare le sue impressioni dall'incontro con Haniel e Illica, avrebbe probabilmente detto: Molto energiche, ottimi corrieri.

Of the "Eibon Anomaly Detectives," most say he looks the most befitting of the 'detective' mantle. Edgar neither denies nor confirms this… Probably because explaining it would be really, really troublesome.
After all, his other titles include "Eibon Ace Trio," "Hyelp's Most Promising Rising Star," "Bridge Crossings' Top 3 Anomaly Hunter," and countless other impressive-sounding nicknames that Nanally, Sakiri, and Taygedo (and sometimes Kiroumaru too) casually make up.

Despite still being a baby-faced boy, he's remarkably mature for his age; almost old-fashioned, likely because the other two are so impulsive that Edgar is always the one left bowing and thanking people. More often than not, he's the one apologizing and paying the bills.
Of course, Edgar's main responsibilities are gathering intel and planning operations. As for how many times those plans have been followed… well, as long as the results are good, who cares? Edgar has come to fully embrace this philosophy; though it doesn't stop him from carefully preparing each time and having a Plan B ready for any unexpected situations that might (or rather, definitely will) occur.
Taygedo often watches the three young Hunters head out and sighs with mock profundity: "Future Edgar will be just like Adler!"
Translation:
Tra i "Detective delle Anomalie di Eibon", molti affermano che sia lui a incarnare meglio il ruolo di 'detective'. Edgar non conferma né smentisce... probabilmente perché dare spiegazioni sarebbe davvero, davvero una seccatura.
Dopotutto, tra i suoi altri titoli figurano "Trio d'Assi di Eibon", "Astro Nascente più Promettente di Hyelp", "Uno dei Migliori 3 Cacciatori di Anomalie di Bridge Crossings" e innumerevoli altri soprannomi altisonanti inventati casualmente da Nanally, Sakiri e Taygedo (e talvolta persino da Kiroumaru).

Sebbene abbia ancora un volto da ragazzino, è straordinariamente maturo per la sua età, quasi all'antica; probabilmente perché le altre due sono così impulsive che tocca sempre a Edgar chinare il capo e ringraziare la gente. Più spesso che no, è lui a doversi scusare e a saldare i conti.
Naturalmente, i compiti principali di Edgar sono la raccolta di informazioni e la pianificazione delle operazioni. Quanto a quante volte questi piani siano stati effettivamente seguiti... beh, finché i risultati sono buoni, a chi importa? Edgar ha ormai abbracciato appieno questa filosofia, anche se ciò non gli impedisce di prepararsi meticolosamente ogni volta e di avere un Piano B pronto per qualsiasi imprevisto che potrebbe verificarsi (o meglio, che sicuramente si verificherà).
Taygedo osserva spesso i tre giovani Cacciatore partire, sospirando con finta solennità: "In futuro Edgar sarà tale e quale ad Adler!"

Source: It'll come in handy eventually.
Translation: Prima o poi tornerà utile.

Source: Another complete mission.
Translation: Un'altra missione completata.

Source: It's finally over!
Translation: È finalmente finita!

Source: My turn!
Translation: Tocca a me!

Source: It seems like Sakiri… keeps a whole lot of things to herself. But as the leader, I'm very tolerant of my family members. Sakiri can continue being herself. I mean, she might just open up to me someday when I'm as powerful as Master Daffodill!
Translation: Sembra che Sakiri… tenga molte cose per sé. Ma in quanto capofamiglia, sono molto tollerante con i miei membri. Sakiri può continuare a essere se stessa. Voglio dire, forse un giorno si confiderà con me, quando sarò potente quanto Maestra Daffodill!

Source: I'm so back!
Translation: Sono tornato alla grande!

Source: Heal I
Translation: Cura I

Source: Heal II
Translation: Cura II

Source: I've been waiting!
Translation: Ti stavo aspettando!

Source: Curses and Prayers
Translation: Maledizioni e Preghiere

Source: Psst, wanna see Nanally freak out? Put on a horror film, and she'll be hugging her tail in no time. Go on, dare her—but don't say I gave you the idea!
Translation: Psst, vuoi vedere Nanally dare di matto? Metti su un film horror e starà abbracciando la sua coda in un attimo. Vai, sfidala—ma non dire che ti ho dato io l'idea!

Source: Welcome to Eibon. I'm Alois V. Adler, the butler. Please, call me Adler. If you need anything, let me know. I'm at your service.
Translation: Benvenuto a Eibon. Sono Alois V. Adler, il maggiordomo. Ti prego, chiamami Adler. Se hai bisogno di qualcosa, fammelo sapere. Sono al tuo servizio.

Source: What can I get for you?
Translation: Cosa posso portarti?

Source: This doesn't look good…
Translation: La cosa non promette bene…

Source: Things are going fairly well.
Translation: Le cose stanno andando abbastanza bene.

Source: Intel trading, anomalies, or ordinary items… Whatever the demand, we're happy to fulfill it.
Translation: Scambio di informazioni, anomalie o oggetti comuni… Qualunque sia la richiesta, siamo felici di soddisfarla.

Source: I don't rush to judgement on intel. I see who is in it, who is into it… Focus on the line and wait, those who hide deeply but always concern will bite the hook.
Translation: Non ho fretta di giudicare le informazioni. Osservo chi c'è dentro, chi ne è coinvolto... Mi concentro sulla lenza e aspetto: coloro che si nascondono nell'ombra ma sono sempre all'erta abboccheranno all'amo.

Source: Intel confirmed.
Translation: Informazioni confermate.

Source: I want to be as organized and meticulous as Adler. I still have so much to learn.
Translation: Voglio essere organizzato e meticoloso come Adler. Ho ancora così tanto da imparare.

Source: I could use an ice pop now…
Translation: Ci vorrebbe proprio un ghiacciolo adesso...

Source: The past? It's rare to meet someone as curious as you. Hmm… where should I begin? How about this: Long, long ago, a young man found a creature by the sea that should only have existed in myths… What later generations would consider the earliest anomaly in Hethereau… Hm? Not the past you were looking for?
Translation: Il passato? È raro incontrare qualcuno di così curioso come te. Mmm… da dove dovrei cominciare? Che ne dici di questo: tanto, tanto tempo fa, un giovane trovò in riva al mare una creatura che sarebbe dovuta esistere solo nei miti… Ciò che le generazioni future avrebbero considerato la prima Anomalia di Hethereau… Mmm? Non era questo il passato che stavi cercando?

Source: I wanna help.
Translation: Voglio aiutare.

Source: If you're looking to kill time, try watching roof tiles in the rain. It's quite fascinating. They shimmer differently than usual, with water droplets bouncing from different angles, creating sounds of different frequencies… almost like someone is trying to whisper something.
Translation: Se vuoi ammazzare il tempo, prova a osservare le tegole sotto la pioggia. È piuttosto affascinante. Luccicano in modo diverso dal solito, con le gocce d'acqua che rimbalzano da angolazioni diverse, creando suoni di frequenze diverse… quasi come se qualcuno stesse cercando di sussurrare qualcosa.

Source: When I first found Taygedo, I was thrilled. Thought I could save on buying a TV. But now the kids hog it every day, watching anime and what not… Sigh. One day, when I strike it rich, I'm getting a screen as big as a wall…
Translation: Quando ho trovato Taygedo per la prima volta, ero entusiasta. Pensavo di poter risparmiare sull'acquisto di una TV. Ma ora i ragazzi la monopolizzano tutti i giorni, guardando anime e quant'altro... Sigh. Un giorno, quando diventerò ricco, prenderò uno schermo grande come un muro...

Source: I'm not a good person to kill time with.
Translation: Non sono una buona compagnia con cui ammazzare il tempo.

Source: Where would you like me to start hurting you?
Translation: Da dove vorresti che iniziassi a farti male?

Source: Want me to make lunch? …Fine, just this once.
Translation: Vuoi che prepari il pranzo? ...E va bene, solo per questa volta.

Source: Want some more?
Translation: Ne vuoi ancora?

Source: I'm not so easily won over.
Translation: Non mi si conquista così facilmente.

Source: Adler, how do you usually take care of tableware?
Translation: Adler, come ti prendi cura di solito delle stoviglie?

Translation: Una piacevole sorpresa.

Translation: Una piacevole sorpresa.

Translation: Una piacevole sorpresa.

Source: What a pleasant surprise—today is turning out to be quite a good day.
Translation: Che piacevole sorpresa—oggi si sta rivelando una giornata piuttosto bella.

Translation: Guadagni Inaspettati I

Translation: Guadagni Inaspettati II

Translation: Questo è inaspettato!

Translation: Una scoperta inaspettata.

Source: Th-Thank you for choosing Pink Paws Bank!
Translation: Gr-Grazie per aver scelto la Banca Pink Paws!

Source: I'll make some once we're back to Eibon.
Translation: Ne preparerò un po' una volta tornati a Eibon.

Source: Feels good.
Translation: Che bella sensazione.

Source: Feeling better now?
Translation: Ti senti meglio ora?

Source: Feeling much better.
Translation: Mi sento molto meglio.
