Ih ih… non c'è bisogno di avere paura, sono solo un piccolo aquilone…

Storia dell'Anomalia:
Quella notte, come sempre, ero sul mio tetto a guardare lo skyline di Hethereau. All'improvviso apparve un aquilone arancione, sospeso a mezz'aria, in controluce rispetto alle luci della città.
Ho pensato tra me e me: "Se fossi quell'aquilone, potrei probabilmente vedere tutta Hethereau da quell'altezza…"
Il pensiero mi ha attraversato la mente, e prima ancora di rendermi conto di cosa stessi facendo, il mio corpo è saltato oltre il bordo del tetto: tuttavia non sono caduto… In realtà avevo afferrato l'aquilone a metà strada. L'aquilone ha manovrato nel cielo come se fossi leggero come una piuma.
"Hethereau è davvero mozzafiato…" ho sussurrato a me stesso.
In quel momento, qualcosa mi ha sfiorato leggermente la spalla. Ho girato la testa per guardare; si è scoperto essere la striscia di coda dell'aquilone, che a un certo punto si era aggrovigliata nel vento. Illuminato dalle luci al neon della città, ho notato due macchie scure e un arco contorto che, a un certo punto, erano emersi sul tessuto dell'aquilone. Aveva una strana somiglianza con un volto umano. Subito dopo, la punta della striscia dell'aquilone si è stretta attorno alla mia spalla, come una pseudo-mano, con una forza brutale. I segni sull'aquilone hanno iniziato a deformarsi e ad allungarsi, formando un volto bizzarro che ha gracchiato orribilmente: "Ih ih!"
"A-aiuto… Aiutatemi!"
Senza pensare lucidamente, ho lasciato andare l'aquilone, dimenticando che ero ancora a migliaia di piedi nel cielo. Proprio mentre mi preparavo a diventare un pezzo d'arte contemporanea sul marciapiede, c'è stato un violento strattone al mio polso. Quella stessa striscia che inizialmente mi aveva afferrato la spalla ora era strettamente avvolta attorno al mio polso. Temendo il peggio, mi sono aggrappato alla striscia e ho tenuto duro per salvarmi la vita. In quel momento è successa una cosa ancora più folle: il volto inquietante e il comportamento dell'aquilone sono stati completamente cancellati. Anche la sua risata maniacale si è fermata. Invece, il dolce suono del vento è stato tutto ciò che ha riempito le mie orecchie. L'aquilone non volava più in modo irregolare e non cercava più di spaventarmi. Piuttosto, continuava a planare dolcemente nel cielo.
"Puoi… puoi riportarmi indietro?" ho chiesto timidamente.
L'aquilone ha svolazzato teneramente, come annuendo. Seguendo la mia guida, l'aquilone si è insinuato tra i grattacieli e gli alti edifici prima di riportarmi finalmente sano e salvo sul tetto su cui mi trovavo prima. Nel momento in cui i miei piedi hanno toccato la terra ferma, la striscia dell'aquilone è rimasta nella mia mano, come se fosse riluttante a lasciarsi andare. Alla fine è scivolata via dal mio palmo ed è volata via. Ho girato la testa per guardarla volare via gradualmente in lontananza. Per un momento fugace, avevo creduto che l'aquilone fosse del tutto ordinario, niente di più.

Quanto sopra costituisce una testimonianza orale di un passante anonimo che ha incontrato l'R-4205(Ob) Aquilone Fantasma.
Forse l'Aquilone Fantasma non è così malvagio come si credeva in precedenza. Le sue espressioni facciali e i suoi gesti spaventosi erano forse un modo goffo per attirare l'attenzione. Quando le sue strisce erano tenute saldamente dalle mani umane, potrebbe aver provato una sottile sensazione di connessione umana. In quello stato "connesso", l'Aquilone Fantasma potrebbe effettivamente fungere da affidabile mezzo di trasporto aereo.

Caratteristiche:
· Un'Anomalia che tende a prendere parte a dispetti e inganni. In genere si traveste da normale aquilone, ma una volta che un umano si avvicina, il "volto" dell'aquilone si distorce in un'espressione beffarda, emettendo una risatina acuta.
· Le strisce di coda apparentemente possiedono una forza tremenda. Gli osservatori hanno affermato che ha un'estrema destrezza e forza, e la capacità di volare nell'aria ad alta velocità.
· Tuttavia, se viene stabilito un contatto fisico con un essere umano, tutti i comportamenti dispettosi o aggressivi cessano immediatamente e l'aquilone diventa invece obbediente e docile.

Nexus dell'Anomalia:

The sea is bleeding.

Anomaly Story
According to the final voyage report, the Pequod had been chasing a whale for forty days. Supplies were nearly exhausted and the crew was at their mental limit, but the whale they pursued was also on its last legs. Harpoon strikes had caused the great beast to bleed, leaving a red trail across the open ocean. The whale was heading towards a field of packed ice, perhaps hoping to force the Pequod to abandon pursuit. Shortly after, both the whale and the Pequod vanished into the packed ice. No one ever saw them again, until we encountered the Sea Prisoner.

R-1851(Or) Sea Prisoner is a large Bio Anomaly resembling a whale-like creature. According to citizen reports, when traversing the undersea tunnels, one can occasionally hear "strange singing." Continuing forward leads into the Sea Prisoner's Anomalous Realm, which resembles packed ice interspersed with shipwrecks and abandoned structures. Inside this Anomalous Realm, water becomes "walkable." The surface remains liquid, but attempting to go below the surface meets resistance. The water composition is similar to seawater, but a period after the Anomalous Realm forms, it turns a vivid blood red. Though harmless to humans, its appearance is gruesome and terrifying leading frightened drivers to abandon their vehicles and flee. Those who do so soon find themselves exiting the Anomalous Realm, back in the undersea tunnel.
The Sea Prisoner appears unable to leave its Anomalous Realm. Based on certain physical characteristics, the Sea Prisoner shares similarities with the whale the Pequod was tracking, but the Sea Prisoner has many additional growths on its body. Some appear to be characteristics of other marine creatures, while others are scars from healed wounds. A massive harpoon is lodged in the Sea Prisoner's back. It is a common whaling cannon model, but far larger than any standard harpoon. The missing Pequod was equipped with the same model, but we have no way to determine whether this particular harpoon belonged to the Pequod. Nevertheless, after confirming it as a Derivative Anomaly of R-1851(Or), we still gave it the name Pequod.
The Sea Prisoner shows no active aggression, and according to those who have encountered it, the Sea Prisoner initially is friendly and seems inclined to communicate. Unfortunately, no one can understand the Sea Prisoner's singing, so what it is trying to express remained unknown for a long time. After entering the Anomalous Realm, the water eventually turns red and the Sea Prisoner exhibits extreme pain, struggling to dislodge the harpoon deeply embedded in its back. Even without malicious intent, the Sea Prisoner's massive size causes tremendous destruction when it thrashes. After being driven mad by agony, the Sea Prisoner begins attacking everything around it indiscriminately.
Those who have encountered the Sea Prisoner generally report sensing that it is suffering gravely. Having Anomalized, it cannot die, and the harpoon on its back will torment it forever. It appears to draw others into its Anomalous Realm as a cry for help, longing for someone to end its pain. After leaving the Anomalous Realm, those who have encountered the Sea Prisoner generally express concern for its condition. A small number develop obsessive symptoms regarding "helping the Sea Prisoner," but we cannot verify whether these changes stem from post-traumatic stress after witnessing its suffering, or whether the Anomalous Realm exerted influence on their minds.

In nearly all ancient beliefs, the sea was a personified deity: generous yet capricious, an embodiment of abundance and disaster alike. Majestic creatures like whales were also imbued with much mythological significance. Yet now, as reverence for the sea has been replaced by a hunger for resources, few stop to ask: What must we give in return? Will endless plundering one day invite the sea's fury?

· The Sea Prisoner is a Bio Anomaly resembling a whale, with characteristics of multiple marine creatures fused together.

Anomaly Nexus
The harpoon embedded in the Anomaly's body.

Potentially high destructive power, but only within the Anomalous Realm. After entering the Anomalous Realm, getting off the vehicle immediately allows one to leave.

Il mare sta sanguinando.

Storia dell'Anomalia
Secondo il rapporto del viaggio finale, la Pequod stava inseguendo una balena da quaranta giorni. Le provviste erano quasi esaurite e l'equipaggio era al limite delle proprie capacità mentali, ma anche la balena che stavano inseguendo era agli sgoccioli. La balena si stava dirigendo verso un campo di ghiaccio compatto, forse sperando di costringere la Pequod ad abbandonare l'inseguimento. Poco dopo, sia la balena che la Pequod svanirono nel ghiaccio compatto. Nessuno le vide più, finché non incontrammo il Prigioniero del Mare.

R-1851(Or) Prigioniero del Mare è una grande Bio Anomalia che assomiglia a una creatura simile a una balena. Secondo le segnalazioni dei cittadini, quando si attraversano i tunnel sottomarini, di tanto in tanto si sente un "canto strano". Proseguendo si entra nel Reame Anomalo del Prigioniero del Mare, che ricorda del ghiaccio compatto intervallato da relitti e strutture abbandonate. All'interno di questo Reame Anomalo, l'acqua diventa "calpestabile". La superficie rimane liquida, ma se si cerca di andare sotto la superficie si incontra resistenza. La composizione dell'acqua è simile a quella dell'acqua di mare, ma un certo periodo dopo la formazione del Reame Anomalo, diventa di un rosso sangue vivo. Sebbene innocua per gli esseri umani, il suo aspetto è raccapricciante e terrificante e porta i conducenti spaventati ad abbandonare i loro veicoli e a fuggire. Coloro che lo fanno si ritrovano presto a uscire dal Reame Anomalo, di nuovo nel tunnel sottomarino.
Il Prigioniero del Mare sembra incapace di lasciare il suo Reame Anomalo. In base a certe caratteristiche fisiche, il Prigioniero del Mare ha delle somiglianze con la balena che la Pequod stava seguendo, ma il Prigioniero del Mare ha molte protuberanze aggiuntive sul suo corpo. Alcune sembrano essere caratteristiche di altre creature marine, mentre altre sono cicatrici di ferite guarite. Un enorme arpione è conficcato nella schiena del Prigioniero del Mare. È un modello comune di cannone baleniero, ma molto più grande di qualsiasi arpione standard. La Pequod scomparsa era equipaggiata con lo stesso modello, ma non abbiamo modo di determinare se questo arpione in particolare appartenesse alla Pequod. Ciononostante, dopo averlo confermato come Anomalia Derivata di R-1851(Or), gli abbiamo comunque dato il nome di Pequod.
Il Prigioniero del Mare non mostra un'aggressività attiva e, secondo chi lo ha incontrato, inizialmente è amichevole e sembra propenso a comunicare. Sfortunatamente, nessuno riesce a capire il canto del Prigioniero del Mare, quindi ciò che sta cercando di esprimere è rimasto sconosciuto per molto tempo. Dopo essere entrati nel Reame Anomalo, l'acqua alla fine diventa rossa e il Prigioniero del Mare mostra un dolore estremo, lottando per sfilare l'arpione profondamente conficcato nella sua schiena. Anche senza intenti malevoli, le enormi dimensioni del Prigioniero del Mare causano tremenda distruzione quando si dimena. Dopo essere stato spinto alla follia dall'agonia, il Prigioniero del Mare inizia ad attaccare indiscriminatamente tutto ciò che lo circonda.
Coloro che hanno incontrato il Prigioniero del Mare generalmente riferiscono di aver percepito che sta soffrendo gravemente. Essendo diventato un'Anomalia, non può morire e l'arpione sulla sua schiena lo tormenterà per sempre. Sembra attrarre gli altri nel suo Reame Anomalo come richiesta di aiuto, desiderando che qualcuno ponga fine al suo dolore. Dopo aver lasciato il Reame Anomalo, coloro che hanno incontrato il Prigioniero del Mare esprimono generalmente preoccupazione per le sue condizioni. Un piccolo numero sviluppa sintomi ossessivi riguardo all'"aiutare il Prigioniero del Mare", ma non possiamo verificare se questi cambiamenti derivino da stress post-traumatico dopo aver assistito alle sue sofferenze, o se il Reame Anomalo abbia esercitato un'influenza sulle loro menti.

In quasi tutte le credenze antiche, il mare era una divinità personificata: generosa ma capricciosa, incarnazione di abbondanza e disastro allo stesso tempo. Creature maestose come le balene erano intrise di molto significato mitologico. Eppure ora, poiché la venerazione per il mare è stata sostituita da una fame di risorse, in pochi si fermano a chiedere: cosa dobbiamo dare in cambio? I saccheggi infiniti un giorno attireranno l'ira del mare?

Caratteristiche dell'Anomalia

Stars reflected on the ocean's surface can be seen, but remain out of reach.

Anomaly Story:
On clear, cloudless nights, twinkling stars will be reflected onto the ocean's surface. However, observers may notice that any alteration in the sky that veils the stars will not be similarly reflected in the water's surface. Instead, the 'stars' in the ocean mirroring those in the sky may not be 'stars' at all.
Once night falls, you might occasionally spot tiny "starlings" drifting up and down on a water's surface, giving off a faint, blue glow. This phenomenon is actually a Bio Anomaly of near microscopic scale. These Bio Anomalies only become clearly visible when clustered together on the surface of a body of water. Typically, the relative positions and luminosity of these clusters align perfectly with the night sky's constellations overhead, forming something akin to a star chart on the water's surface. Because of this, the Anomaly has been deemed: "Aqua Astra".
The lifespan of a single Aqua Astra is incredibly short, often only lasting one night before undergoing natural nullification.
When the moon sets and the sun begins to rise, the glow of the Aqua Astra begins to fade. Observation and documentation suggest that Aqua Astra does not affect any other lifeforms in the same body of water it inhabits. As of right now, the only noted effect of Aqua Astra is to reflect the night sky on a surface of water.

Characteristics:
· Aqua Astra is an aquatic Bio Anomaly, with sightings recorded across multiple natural bodies of water of various sizes. As of now, Aqua Astra has not been observed in small artificial pools such as open-air swimming pools or storage tanks.
· A single Aqua Astra persists for only one night before undergoing spontaneous nullification.
· Each Aqua Astra cluster imitates a different constellation. There has been no noted documentation on how these clusters determine which constellation to replicate.

Anomaly Nexus:
Automatically nullifies after sunrise.

Risk Assessment:
Harmless.

Containment Status:
Since Aqua Astra will nullify itself after a set period, no method has been found to fully contain it or trigger early nullification.

Containment Procedures:
No containment procedures required.

Lucky, Lucky… Please come back to me.

Anomaly Story
In an apartment somewhere in Hethereau, a dog named Lucky once lived with its owner, an employee of the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Lucky remembered it clearly: during that period, Anomaly cases were frequent and staff was short, so its owner had to work overtime almost every day until very, very late. Lucky, left waiting at home for its owner, felt like the loneliest little dog in the world… The owner noticed of this too, so during work, they secretly connected to the home computer's video feed. When Lucky saw its owner appear on one of the screens at home, it happily pounced forward, only to bump its nose unexpectedly. Seeing Lucky's awkward state, the owner couldn't help but laugh. Basking in the owner's smile, Lucky felt the pain in its nose fade away and stuck out its tongue, laughing along. "Once work is done, I'll come back to Lucky." Lucky remembered those words and understood that the only thing between them was this hard piece of glass that must be called "work." If only I could do "work" too, Lucky told itself, gazing at its owner hunched over the desk on the other side of the screen. If work finished sooner, the two would be reunited sooner…
Later, on one ordinary rainy night, Lucky watched its owner through the screen as usual. It noticed the owner had gotten thinner, and the dark circles under their eyes were more obvious, but the dedication to work had never changed. Lucky barked twice, trying to convey the deepest concern a little dog could imagine: Owner, you should rest! Work can be slower, Lucky isn't afraid of being lonely! Just being able to watch the owner like this is enough!
Suddenly, the screen emitted a blinding light that illuminated the entire apartment, and Lucky instinctively closed its eyes. As the light gradually dimmed and Lucky opened its eyes again, all it saw was darkness. Unable to sense its owner, Lucky frantically barked, scratched at the door, and paced around the room anxiously until it collapsed on the floor, exhausted. Lucky tried to comfort itself, thinking: The owner must be on the way home! It dragged its tired body to crouch by the door, waiting anxiously. One hour passed, two hours passed, one day passed, two days passed, but the familiar footsteps never came from outside the door again.
"Am I abandoned?" This possibility never even crossed Lucky's mind… After all, the owner said that once all the work was done, they would come back to Lucky!
A few more days passed. Lucky stared blankly at the dark computer screen, missing its owner deeply. Maybe… maybe now is the time when the owner needs me! This thought suddenly appeared in Lucky's mind. I can't just sit around doing nothing anymore. Lucky took a deep breath and opened the door.
Opened… the door…?
Lucky looked down in astonishment and found itself standing on its two hind legs, having just opened the door with its front paws, just like its owner. After a period of surprise, Lucky quickly adapted to its new body. Thinking about finding its owner filled it with strength.
A dog walking upright naturally caused quite a commotion in Hethereau. The Bureau of Anomaly Control soon received the message and, after determining it was an unregistered Bio Anomaly, dispatched two staff members to view the situation. When Lucky saw people wearing the same uniform as its owner, it happily ran up to them. Just as one of the staff was about to pull the trigger on a tranquilizer gun, the other recognized Lucky. "Aren't you Lucky? That kid in the office was always insisting on showing us photos of you!" he said, and brought Lucky to the Bureau of Anomaly Control.
The moment Lucky entered the Bureau's doors, a long-missed scent hit its nose! Following the scent, Lucky found a desk piled high with documents, with a photo framed at the corner of the desk of the owner and Lucky together. So the owner hadn't come home to be with Lucky because "work" wasn't finished! Lucky finally relaxed and grinned. It wagged its tail, wiped the dust off the photo, and then did something that shocked everyone: it began working, as naturally as could be.
The Lieutenant of ETD-4, who had rushed over upon hearing the news, stared with awe at the scene. He seemed to completely understand Lucky's feelings. This understanding Lieutenant exchanged a few words with the nearby staff, abandoned the original plan to contain Lucky. From then on, Lucky stayed at the Bureau of Anomaly Control, and was even given an official title: Agent.LUCK.
It must be said that Agent.LUCK's ability and energy amazed almost everyone. Unfinished work was like enemy number one in LUCK's eyes. As its work scope expanded, LUCK even revealed a new ability: rapidly teleporting between two lit computer screens. With this ability, LUCK could efficiently handle work from other departments.
The Bureau of Anomaly Control's search and rescue for the mysteriously vanished employee continues, but LUCK no longer worries. Deep in this dog's heart, it firmly believes that its owner is watching it work from somewhere, just as LUCK once watched its owner work through that little screen. "Once work is done, LUCK will come back to me." It seems the owner's gentle voice still echoes in its ears from time to time. So LUCK buries its head deeper in work… This is how the owner felt back then, faster, even faster! Once all the work is done, Agent.LUCK… no, Lucky will return to its owner's side, and they'll never be apart again.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Like a little dog, it has endless energy, but LUCK seems to devote all of it to work, to an astonishingly dedicated degree.
· LUCK can teleport through lit computer screens within the Bureau of Anomaly Control, helping handle work from various departments.

Anomaly Nexus
While the Anomaly is teleporting through screens, simultaneously turn off the power to both screens.

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Unique Anomaly, guaranteed by the Bureau of Anomaly Control

Translation:
Lucky, Lucky… Per favore, torna da me.

Storia dell'Anomalia
In un appartamento da qualche parte a Hethereau, un cane di nome Lucky viveva con il suo padrone, un impiegato dell'Ufficio Anomalie. Lucky lo ricordava bene: in quel periodo, i casi di Anomalia erano frequenti e il personale scarseggiava, quindi il suo padrone doveva fare gli straordinari quasi tutti i giorni fino a molto, molto tardi. Lucky, lasciato ad aspettare a casa il suo padrone, si sentiva come il cagnolino più solo del mondo… Anche il padrone se ne accorse, così durante il lavoro si collegò segretamente al feed video del computer di casa. Quando Lucky vide apparire il suo padrone su uno degli schermi di casa, balzò in avanti felice, finendo solo per sbattere inaspettatamente il naso. Vedendo lo stato goffo di Lucky, il padrone non poté fare a meno di ridere. Crogiolandosi nel sorriso del padrone, Lucky sentì il dolore al naso svanire e tirò fuori la lingua, ridendo insieme a lui. "Una volta finito il lavoro, tornerò da Lucky." Lucky ricordò quelle parole e capì che l'unica cosa tra loro era questo duro pezzo di vetro che doveva essere chiamato "lavoro". Se solo potessi fare il "lavoro" anch'io, si disse Lucky, fissando il suo padrone curvo sulla scrivania dall'altra parte dello schermo. Se il lavoro finisse prima, si riunirebbero prima…
In seguito, in una normale notte di pioggia, Lucky guardò il suo padrone attraverso lo schermo come al solito. Notò che il padrone era dimagrito e le occhiaie sotto i suoi occhi erano più evidenti, ma la dedizione al lavoro non era mai cambiata. Lucky abbaiò due volte, cercando di trasmettere la preoccupazione più profonda che un cagnolino potesse immaginare: Padrone, dovresti riposarti! Il lavoro può essere più lento, Lucky non ha paura di sentirsi solo! Basta solo poterti guardare così!
Improvvisamente, lo schermo emise una luce accecante che illuminò l'intero appartamento, e Lucky istintivamente chiuse gli occhi. Quando la luce si affievolì gradualmente e Lucky riaprì gli occhi, tutto ciò che vide fu oscurità. Incapace di percepire il suo padrone, Lucky abbaiò freneticamente, graffiò la porta e camminò per la stanza ansiosamente fino a crollare sul pavimento, esausto. Lucky cercò di confortarsi, pensando: il padrone deve essere sulla via del ritorno! Trascinò il suo corpo stanco per accucciarsi vicino alla porta, aspettando con ansia. Passò un'ora, passarono due ore, passò un giorno, passarono due giorni, ma i passi familiari non arrivarono mai più da fuori dalla porta.
"Sono stato abbandonato?" Questa possibilità non sfiorò nemmeno la mente di Lucky… Dopotutto, il padrone aveva detto che una volta finito tutto il lavoro, sarebbe tornato da Lucky!
Passarono altri giorni. Lucky fissava assente lo schermo scuro del computer, con profonda nostalgia del suo padrone. Forse… forse ora è il momento in cui il padrone ha bisogno di me! Questo pensiero apparve improvvisamente nella mente di Lucky. Non posso più starmene seduto a non fare niente. Lucky fece un respiro profondo e aprì la porta.
Ha aperto… la porta…?
Lucky guardò giù stupito e si ritrovò in piedi sulle due zampe posteriori, avendo appena aperto la porta con le zampe anteriori, proprio come il suo padrone. Dopo un primo momento di sorpresa, Lucky si adattò rapidamente al suo nuovo corpo. Il pensiero di trovare il suo padrone lo riempì di forza.
Un cane che camminava in posizione eretta causò naturalmente un bel trambusto a Hethereau. L'Ufficio Anomalie ricevette presto il messaggio e, dopo aver stabilito che si trattava di un'Anomalia biologica non registrata, inviò due membri dello staff per verificare la situazione. Quando Lucky vide persone che indossavano la stessa uniforme del suo padrone, corse felicemente verso di loro. Proprio mentre uno dello staff stava per premere il grilletto di un fucile tranquillante, l'altro riconobbe Lucky. "Ma non sei Lucky? Quel ragazzo in ufficio insisteva sempre per mostrarci le tue foto!" disse, e portò Lucky all'Ufficio Anomalie.
Nel momento in cui Lucky varcò le porte dell'Ufficio, un profumo che gli mancava da tempo colpì il suo naso! Seguendo il profumo, Lucky trovò una scrivania piena zeppa di documenti, con una foto incorniciata nell'angolo in cui c'erano il padrone e Lucky insieme. Quindi il padrone non era tornato a casa per stare con Lucky perché il "lavoro" non era finito! Lucky finalmente si rilassò e sorrise. Scodinzolò, tolse la polvere dalla foto, e poi fece qualcosa che scioccò tutti: iniziò a lavorare, con la massima naturalezza.

When the Bureau began studying the Ghost Train's characteristics, an owl-shaped Oddity suddenly fluttered out of the empty conductor's cab. According to this Oddity, otherwise known as Miss Levi, the Ghost Train wants something very simple: a desire to deliver passengers to their destination. Alongside the Zerogon Laboratory and the Ghost Train (represented by Miss Levi, the Conductor), the BAC drafted the Passenger Manual to ensure passenger safety. Any traveler who wishes to take the Ghost Train must adhere to and fully understand the Passenger Manual and pass the Ghost Train Qualification Exam at the Bureau.

Access denied.

Containment Procedures:
No containment procedures required.

To verify the accuracy of the Ghost Train Passenger Manual, Zerogon Laboratory designed targeted experiments for each rule. Only a small excerpt is recorded in this log. To access the full log, please submit a request to Zerogon Laboratory.

Corresponding rule: Section 6 of the Ghost Train Passenger Manual: "Except on suspension days, whenever a passenger is waiting on the platform, the Ghost Train will arrive within one minute".

Objective: Verify how the Ghost Train responds to waiting passenger behavior.

Method:
On a non-suspension day, multiple test groups were arranged on the same platform for comparison:
· Group I: 1 Passenger, normally waiting on the platform;
· Group II: no humans, only a humanoid dummy placed in a waiting posture;
· Group III: 1 Passenger present, but instead of waiting at a fixed point, they walk repeatedly around the station;
· Group IV: 1 Passenger in a waiting posture on the platform, but silently and repeatedly thinking negative phrases such as "I don't need to ride" and "The train isn't coming."
The observers recorded whether the Ghost Train arrived, its arrival time, and whether the doors opened.

Results:
With test subjects from Groups I, III, and IV present, the train arrived within one minute;
Group II did not trigger any response;
In Group IV, although the train arrived, its doors never opened.

Conclusion:
The Ghost Train's judgment of "a passenger is waiting" is based on the passenger's actual presence and a recognized intention to board. Whether that intention is valid has nothing to do with outward behavior. The exact method by which the Ghost Train confirms a Passenger's intent still requires further study.

Unknown. Subduing this Anomaly by force is presumed to be the most effective method.

May we all have a wonderful tomorrow!

Anomaly Story
Once upon a time, there was an ordinary tree stood among many equally ordinary trees. Back then, where it grew was still a dense forest with rugged terrain, with many ferocious beasts roaming about. Residents of the nearby villages made their living from logging, and woodcutters and hunters had no choice but to venture into the forest to gather resources and hunt. One day, someone passing by this tree tied a strip of cloth to one of its branches, both to mark the path and to wish for a safe return home. Gradually, more and more people grew accustomed to leaving something under the tree, wishing for blessings for themselves and their families. This practice gave way to tradition, and as humans expanded their farmland and cleared the forest, this unique tree was preserved and given its name: Fortune Shades.
Ages passed, and towering buildings rose from the ground. Those villages of old no longer exist, having long been replaced by a metropolis called Hethereau. And yet, Fortune Shades, having weathered the years, has grown into a magnificent tree. It still watches over each person who comes to make a wish, quietly waiting for their wishes to take root and flourish. The accumulated wishes have granted it the ability to bestow happiness to a certain degree, making it a unique Anomaly. This is the origin of Fortune Shades.

Wishing under the Fortune Shades produces a sapling. When the sapling is placed at Fortune Shades' roots, it is absorbed by the tree, and people's wishes are absorbed along with it, becoming nourishment for its growth. In return, Fortune Shades provides some form of small blessing to those who make their wishes. Sometimes it's winning a free drink. Sometimes it's nearly tripping but just happening to catch a nearby tree for support. Such small strokes of luck often brighten someone's entire day. As for wishes that are harder to fulfill, such as curing a family member's illness or performing exceptionally well in an entrance exam, even if they do come true, it's difficult to credit Fortune Shades.

Based on existing evidence, Fortune Shades shares certain characteristics with ordinary trees. Fortune Shades needs to absorb people's wishes as nourishment, and to ensure people continue coming to make wishes, it offers small blessings in return. This is much like how plants reward birds with delicious fruit, so that they may carry away their seeds. However, the nourishment each person can provide is very limited, so Fortune Shades can only bring people good fortune within an even smaller scope.
For most people who wish, the act of wishing is itself a form of psychological comfort. Often, the act of wishing matters far more than actually receiving anything in return. From the days when we ate raw meat and tilled the land with fire, to today's age of towering skyscrapers… wishing has always carried humanity's hopes for a better tomorrow. It is the determination to pursue happiness and the courage to overcome hardship. Fortune Shades watches over those who work hard for a better tomorrow day and night, drawing nourishment from their pursuit of happiness, and giving each person who tries their best its own small gift.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Wishing under Fortune Shades produces a sapling. Returning it to the roots allows Fortune Shades to absorb both the sapling and the wish.
· Pure and sincere wishes will receive blessings from Fortune Shades.

Anomaly Nexus
Extended periods without wishes, causing accumulated power to be depleted.

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Given Fortune Shades' fame, difficulty of relocation, and symbolic significance, on-site containment measures have been adopted. It is supervised by the Bureau of Anomaly Control, with maintenance handled by the Hethereau Municipality.

Containment Measures
Early plans called for transplant containment measures, relocating Fortune Shades to Celaeno Compound for containment. However, Fortune Shades loses its power upon leaving its original coordinates and recovers only upon returning. Considering the difficulty of containment, safety, and symbolic significance, on-site containment measures were adopted for Fortune Shades, supervised by the Bureau of Anomaly Control with maintenance by the Hethereau Municipality. After the failed transplant attempt, Yggash Court classified Fortune Shades as a Location Anomaly.

Experiment Records
1. Experiment: Removing a sapling from Fortune Shades.
Result: The sapling disappeared after leaving Fortune Shades.
2. Experiment: After wishing, not placing the sapling at Fortune Shades' roots.
Result: After 300 seconds, the sapling disappeared.
3. Experiment: Wishing at the Fortune Shades to see the deceased ■■■ once more.
Result: The wish was not fulfilled.
Note: The one who made the wish was Researcher ■■■, who did not complete the required application and registration before conducting the experiment. Researcher ■■■ claimed they visited in a personal capacity and did not need to follow procedures. They have been formally reprimanded.
Note 2: Researcher ■■■ claimed to have seen the deceased ■■■ in a dream and said their final goodbye. There is no evidence linking this event to Fortune Shades.

They organized a creative technique exchange, with this collision of ideas flowing from their pens as ink. Ideas converged into the invisible current of thought that gave birth to countless magnificent imaginary worlds and unforgettable stories. Several weeks later, the mansion doors suddenly creaked opened on their own. However, what emerged was not the writers, but a true torrent of consciousness. Anyone submerged in it will inevitably be affected, experiencing visual and auditory hallucinations, or developing more severe mental issues. During the containment process, one must watch for another relatively inconspicuous substance in the World Beyond the Door: the "droplets of reason." Like the "torrent of consciousness," these appear to be liquid in form, but unlike the ceaselessly surging torrent, they are often stationary spheres of water. Touching the "droplets of reason" will reduce the mental contamination suffered during the containment process, and also stabilize the surrounding "torrent of consciousness" to some degree, allowing passage with less risk to one's sanity.
Touching the "droplets of reason" is not without a price, however. Outside the Inner Door was born from the wild imaginings of writers, and reason is like poison to them. Touching the "droplets of reason" will provoke retaliation from the Anomaly. Close all doors connecting reality to the World Beyond the Door.

Guaranteed by the Ebisu Auction House.

The closed Outside the Inner Door can be stored in any space large enough to accommodate it. Considering that opening the door is the trigger for an breach, it is recommended to lay it flat on a solid surface.

The justice we represent must be justice for all.

Anomaly Story
Long before Hethereau's justice system was as well developed as it is today, the mysterious and powerful Anomaly known as Justice Executioner had already been officially registered. According to existing records, this Anomaly is normally invisible, believed to lurk beneath the city's roads. It resides somewhere deeper than the darkest sewers, in a place that cannot be observed or reached… Notably, Justice Executioner is not a single entity, but an entire forest of steel traffic lights. It is said that this forest listens to the pulse of every road in the city, and when a perpetrator whose crimes have reached an extreme appears, it randomly selects a car near the offender. A giant traffic light tree then bursts from the ground and takes control of the vehicle, temporarily utilizing it as a vessel for executing punishment. Perhaps from this, one can speculate that the Anomaly originally emerged from citizens' frustration with frequent traffic chaos and their strong desire for just law enforcement. In reality, very few people have actually seen Justice Executioner, since troublemakers can be handled by Security Officers and Officer Whiskers nowadays. Only the rare few thugs that even the Security Office struggles to deal with will disturb this dormant Anomaly, and they usually collapse before they even realize what terrifying colossus stands before them. Put simply, they faint from sheer fright… What kind of punishment Justice Executioner inflicts upon these people, how it hands criminals over to the Security Office for official processing, and why almost everyone refuses to speak of those encounters remains unknown to us.
Due to its rare appearances, Justice Executioner has gradually become regarded as one of Hethereau's many urban legends, though it carries a certain deterrent power that ordinary rumors lack. Some parents embellish stories about Justice Executioner to tell their children, using them to teach obedience to the law. For example: "Stay close to adults when crossing the street and don't run around, or the monster hiding underground will take away naughty children." "You can't just take other people's things. That monster who loves children the most will come catch you if it finds out." "Those bullies who always pick on others will definitely be defeated by that justice-enforcing Anomaly no matter where they run!" And so on… As you can see, the duties Justice Executioner has taken on in folklore have exceeded its actual responsibilities, having become a symbol of absolute justice. For ordinary citizens, its existence is like a blade lurking in the shadows, ignored most of the time. But once an uncontrollable situation occurs, it will exercise its authority and eliminate all threats to peace.
As mentioned earlier, Justice Executioner is an entire forest of traffic lights. Interestingly, Officer Whiskers are said to live within this tangled jungle of branches, forming a peculiar symbiotic relationship between these anomalies. Therefore, some anomaly researchers speculate that the Whiskers help maintain and repair Justice Executioner's traffic light branches. In return, Justice Executioner provides the Officer Whiskers with a place to rest and train. Whatever the true situation may be, their cooperation has remained remarkably stable and harmonious to this day.
As a member of ETD-6 once claimed: "Justice delayed is justice denied." This powerful Anomaly seems to share this view, rising from the ground when the Security Office is overwhelmed and extinguishing all violence within its Anomalous Realm in a timely manner. With such powerful and decisive methods, Justice Executioner serves as the Security Office's most formidable secret weapon, safeguarding this city's peace and tranquility.

Anomaly Characteristics
· An extraordinarily powerful Anomaly that only appears when city crime reaches a certain level, pulling perpetrators into its Anomalous Realm.
· Not a single entity, but an entire forest of traffic lights. Officer Whiskers are said to reside within it.

Anomaly Nexus
Insufficient permissions. Currently unable to access.

Risk Assessment
Extremely high hazard. Does not normally appear. Only manifests when major criminal incidents occur.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Unique Anomaly. Guaranteed by the Security Office.

Containment Measures
Not in containment.

Translation:
La giustizia che rappresentiamo deve essere giustizia per tutti.

Storia dell'Anomalia
Molto prima che il sistema giudiziario di Hethereau fosse sviluppato come lo è oggi, l'Anomalia misteriosa e potente nota come Esecutore di Giustizia era già stata ufficialmente registrata. Secondo i registri esistenti, questa Anomalia è normalmente invisibile, ritenuta in agguato sotto le strade della città. Risiede da qualche parte più in profondità delle fogne più oscure, in un luogo che non può essere osservato o raggiunto... In particolare, l'Esecutore di Giustizia non è una singola entità, ma un'intera foresta di semafori d'acciaio. Si dice che questa foresta ascolti il battito di ogni strada della città e, quando compare un criminale i cui crimini hanno raggiunto un livello estremo, selezioni a caso un'auto vicino al colpevole. Un gigantesco albero semaforo poi erutta dal suolo e prende il controllo del veicolo, utilizzandolo temporaneamente come vascello per eseguire la punizione. Forse da questo si può dedurre che l'Anomalia sia originariamente emersa dalla frustrazione dei cittadini per i frequenti problemi nel traffico e dal loro forte desiderio per una giusta applicazione della legge. In realtà, pochissime persone hanno effettivamente visto l'Esecutore di Giustizia, poiché oggigiorno i piantagrane possono essere gestiti dagli Ufficiali della Sicurezza e dall'Agente Whiskers. Solo i rari teppisti che anche l'Ufficio Sicurezza fatica a gestire disturberanno questa Anomalia dormiente, e di solito crollano prima ancora di rendersi conto di quale terrificante colosso si erga di fronte a loro. In parole povere, svengono per il puro terrore... Che tipo di punizione l'Esecutore di Giustizia infligga a queste persone, come consegni i criminali all'Ufficio Sicurezza per le pratiche ufficiali e perché quasi tutti si rifiutino di parlare di quegli incontri rimane a noi sconosciuto.
A causa delle sue rare apparizioni, l'Esecutore di Giustizia è gradualmente diventato una delle tante leggende metropolitane di Hethereau, sebbene porti con sé un certo potere deterrente che manca alle voci ordinarie. Alcuni genitori abbelliscono le storie sull'Esecutore di Giustizia per raccontarle ai figli, usandole per insegnare loro l'obbedienza alla legge. Ad esempio: "Stai vicino agli adulti quando attraversi la strada e non correre in giro, o il mostro che si nasconde sottoterra porterà via i bambini cattivi." "Non puoi semplicemente prendere le cose degli altri. Quel mostro che ama di più i bambini verrà a prenderti se lo scopre." "Quei bulli che se la prendono sempre con gli altri saranno sicuramente sconfitti da quell'Anomalia giustiziera non importa dove fuggano!" E così via... Come si può vedere, i compiti che l'Esecutore di Giustizia ha assunto nel folklore hanno superato le sue responsabilità effettive, diventando un simbolo di giustizia assoluta. Per i cittadini comuni, la sua esistenza è come una lama in agguato nell'ombra, ignorata la maggior parte del tempo. Ma una volta che si verifica una situazione incontrollabile, eserciterà la sua autorità ed eliminerà tutte le minacce alla pace.
Come accennato in precedenza, l'Esecutore di Giustizia è un'intera foresta di semafori. Curiosamente, si dice che gli Agenti Whiskers vivano all'interno di questa intricata giungla di rami, formando una peculiare relazione simbiotica tra queste anomalie. Pertanto, alcuni ricercatori di anomalie ipotizzano che i Whiskers aiutino a mantenere e riparare i rami semaforici dell'Esecutore di Giustizia. In cambio, l'Esecutore di Giustizia fornisce agli Agenti Whiskers un posto dove riposare e addestrarsi. Qualunque sia la vera situazione, la loro cooperazione è rimasta notevolmente stabile e armoniosa fino ad oggi.
Come un membro dell'ETD-6 affermò una volta: "La giustizia ritardata è giustizia negata." Questa potente Anomalia sembra condividere questa visione, ergendosi dal suolo quando l'Ufficio Sicurezza è sopraffatto e annientando ogni violenza all'interno del suo Reame Anomalo in modo tempestivo. Con metodi così potenti e decisivi, l'Esecutore di Giustizia funge da arma segreta più formidabile dell'Ufficio Sicurezza, salvaguardando la pace e la tranquillità di questa città.

Caratteristiche dell'Anomalia
· Un'Anomalia straordinariamente potente che appare solo quando la criminalità cittadina raggiunge un certo livello, trascinando i criminali nel suo Reame Anomalo.
· Non un'entità singola, ma un'intera foresta di semafori. Si dice che gli Agenti Whiskers risiedano al suo interno.

Nexus dell'Anomalia
Permessi insufficienti. Attualmente impossibile da accedere.

Valutazione del Rischio
Pericolo estremamente alto. Normalmente non appare. Si manifesta solo quando si verificano gravi incidenti criminali.

Anomalia Unica. Garantito dall'Ufficio Sicurezza.

Those who dream, stay dreaming. This is deemed the First Law of Somnodynamics.

Anomaly Story:
Wakeybee is an Anomaly that has extensive documentation. Scattered records of its presence show up all throughout history, with a primary focus on the unique honey it produces. There is written evidence of Wakeybee honey being utilized in historical battles, assassinations, and so on.
The Wakeybee has the appearance of a common honeybee, though far larger in size. When flying, their wings produce almost no sound. As a result, Wakeybees can approach drowsy individuals and siphon their "sleepiness". Those that are siphoned by the Wakeybee often claim that they were not aware of the siphoning itself, but that they felt incredibly energized post-siphoning. Individuals experiencing severe sleep deprivation have a higher chance of attracting a Wakeybee.
The Wakeybee has the unique ability to utilize siphoned fatigue, drowsiness, and exhaustion, and transform it into Somnosweet—the Wakeybee's distinctive honey product. When ingested, Somnosweet can be used as a sleep aid. However, excessive ingestion of Somnosweet can result in extreme mental fatigue and can even be fatal.

Somnosweet is primarily used by those who need assistance with adjusting their sleep schedules. This can be due to a change in routine, a malfunctioning circadian rhythm, or individuals suffering from extreme insomnia. However, it's imperative to note that Somnosweet is only a temporary solution for the challenges previously listed. Getting proper, natural rest takes precedence over any Somnosweet-induced respite.

Characteristics:
· A larger version of the common honeybee.
· Primarily survives through the siphoning of fatigued individuals.
· Absorbed fatigue can be converted into Somnosweet by the Wakeybee.

Anomaly Nexus:
Nullification occurs if absorbed fatigue is insufficient over long intervals.

Risk Assessment:
Harmless.

Containment Status:
A certain number are contained at the Celaeno Compound and the Anomaly sanctuary, "Sunward Island". Qualified individuals may act as Guarantors, but no Guarantor may keep more than one Wakeybee, and any Somnosweet obtained may not be privately traded or gifted.

Containment Procedures:
No special containment procedures required.

Experiment Record:
"Preliminary Study on Anomaly 'Wakeybee' and Its Honey Production"
Case Overview: The limits of Wakeybee in resisting drowsiness.
Wakeybees exclusively siphon from human subjects; thus, no research can currently be conducted on Wakeybee siphoning for ethical reasons. As a result, we must observe historical usages of the Wakeybee. Based on recorded history, the longest documented duration a human remained awake due to Wakeybee siphoning is 140 hours. Disclaimer: We do not condone nor encourage the usage of Somnosweet or the Wakeybee to remain awake for extended periods of time. The effect of the Wakeybee's siphoning only gives the illusion of fatigue removal. The body and mind will still suffer from sleep deprivation, which can lead to serious health problems.

Test subject ■■■ volunteered to test Wakeybee honey effects, while explicitly under the protection of an Anomaly capable of forced mental stimulation. When a single dose exceeded 50g, the subject stopped responding to most conventional waking methods. When a single dose exceeded 80g, the subject's breathing and heartbeat were both significantly suppressed—suppression that lifted immediately upon waking.
We recommend that the daily intake of Wakeybee honey not exceed 15g, and that continuous use be heavily limited and monitored. Relevant experiment records are as follows:

Home is the source of our strength.

Anomaly Story
Long, long ago, a count signed a contract with the devil, gaining all the world's riches and glory, and in exchange becoming a vampire who sustained eternal youth by drinking human blood. As the price, he could never leave his own domain. The count soon grew weary of the familiar flora and fauna, birds and beasts, fish and insects on his land. Even the blood offered by his trembling subjects became difficult to swallow down. He devised a solution: using soil from his domain, he crafted a perfect miniature castle model, then used magic to shrink himself down and live inside it. This way, as long as he carried his "castle" with him, he could venture anywhere beyond the walls he had long been confined to. Four hundred years later, he chanced upon a beautiful lady…
These Legendary tales are of course fabricated by later generations, but the castle at the root of this legend, the "Hospitable House," does exist. Records and legends about the "Hospitable House" date back centuries. Very few Anomalies can persist across such a long span of time without undergoing nullification. The origins of the "Hospitable House" can no longer be traced. It has continuously changed hands among collectors, and currently belongs to the collection of the antique shop "Eibon."

The Hospitable House appears to be a miniature castle model. Its interior is exquisitely decorated with complete sets of furniture. Setting aside its size, it is practically a fully livable castle. The appearance and decor of the Hospitable House change slightly with the times, making it impossible to deduce its era of origin from its architectural design or interior decoration style. Today's Hospitable House has complete water, electricity, and lighting facilities for "guests" who enter to use freely. How these facilities operate without any actual utility connections remains an unsolved mystery.
After opening the door to the Hospitable House, humans within a certain range (as well as certain Oddities) are recognized as "guests" by the Hospitable House. "Guests" are shrunk to a size matching the Hospitable House and can temporarily enter for a tour. During this process, the guests' personal items are also shrunk along with them and continue to function normally. The shrinking effect lasts for 7 minutes, after which "guests" are teleported outside the Hospitable House and restored to their original size. Opening the door again allows another tour, but each visit is limited to 7 minutes. This has caused no end of frustration for directors hoping to use the Hospitable House's interior for filming.
The shrinking limit does not apply to those the Hospitable House recognizes as "masters" or "enemies." These individuals do not automatically return to normal size after shrinking, and only the "master" knows how to restore them. The Hospitable House is as sturdy as a real castle, allowing this otherwise harmless Anomaly to protect its "master" or trap "enemies" when necessary. Once, a thief accidentally touched the door of the Hospitable House and remained shrunk for an entire night. Only after swearing to the Hospitable House's "master" that he would turn over a new leaf, he was restored to his original size.

The Hospitable House's long existence without nullification has piqued the curiosity of some scholars: what is its Nexus? One theory, drawing from the legend, suggests that the Hospitable House's Nexus is its "homeland," the place where it was first born. Though unverifiable, the Hospitable House's "homeland" is likely a settlement that still exists. Until that place is destroyed, the Hospitable House will continue to exist. This also explains why the Hospitable House's decor and facilities keep up with the times. The development of its homeland is reflected in the Hospitable House, and it delights in showing visitors the progress of its hometown.
This theory has not been confirmed, but in this writer's opinion, it is quite romantic. For an Anomaly with many legends that is safe and harmless, maintaining its mystique and leaving room for imagination may be the best outcome.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Appears as an exquisite miniature castle model.
· After opening the door to the Hospitable House, humans within a certain range (as well as certain Oddities) are recognized as "guests" by the Hospitable House and shrunk to a size that allows them to tour the castle.
· The shrinking effect lasts for 7 minutes. Playing the pipe organ inside the Hospitable House can end the tour early and restore visitors to their original size.
· The 7-minute time limit does not apply to those the Hospitable House recognizes as "masters" or "enemies." Only the "master" of the Hospitable House knows how to restore them.

Anomaly Nexus
Unknown

Risk Assessment
Harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Given that the Hospitable House does not move on its own and poses no danger, it was decided after evaluation not to contain it. Currently part of the Eibon Antique Shop Collection.

Containment Measures
No special containment measures required.

Translation:
La casa è la fonte della nostra forza.

Storia dell'Anomalia
Molto, molto tempo fa, un conte firmò un contratto col diavolo, ottenendo tutte le ricchezze e la gloria del mondo, e in cambio divenne un vampiro che manteneva l'eterna giovinezza bevendo sangue umano. Come prezzo, non avrebbe mai più potuto lasciare il proprio dominio. Il conte si stancò presto della solita flora e fauna, degli uccelli e delle bestie, dei pesci e degli insetti della sua terra. Anche il sangue offerto dai suoi sudditi tremanti divenne difficile da ingoiare. Ideò una soluzione: usando il terreno del suo dominio, creò un perfetto modello in miniatura del suo castello, poi usò la magia per rimpicciolirsi e viverci dentro. In questo modo, finché avesse portato con sé il suo "castello", avrebbe potuto avventurarsi ovunque oltre le mura in cui era stato a lungo confinato. Quattrocento anni dopo, si imbatté in una bellissima dama…
Questi racconti leggendari sono ovviamente stati fabbricati dalle generazioni successive, ma il castello alla base di questa leggenda, la "Casa Ospitale", esiste davvero. Le registrazioni e le leggende sulla "Casa Ospitale" risalgono a secoli fa. Pochissime Anomalie possono persistere per un periodo di tempo così lungo senza subire un annullamento. Le origini della "Casa Ospitale" non possono più essere rintracciate. È passata continuamente di mano tra i collezionisti e attualmente appartiene alla collezione del negozio di antiquariato "Eibon".

La Casa Ospitale si presenta come uno squisito modello di castello in miniatura. Il suo interno è finemente decorato con set completi di mobili. A parte le sue dimensioni, è praticamente un castello pienamente vivibile. L'aspetto e l'arredamento della Casa Ospitale cambiano leggermente con i tempi, rendendo impossibile dedurre la sua era di origine dal design architettonico o dallo stile della decorazione interna. La Casa Ospitale di oggi dispone di impianti completi di acqua, elettricità e illuminazione di cui gli "ospiti" che vi entrano possono usufruire liberamente. Come questi impianti funzionino senza alcun reale collegamento alle utenze rimane un mistero irrisolto.
Dopo aver aperto la porta della Casa Ospitale, gli umani entro un certo raggio (così come alcune Stranezze) vengono riconosciuti come "ospiti" dalla Casa Ospitale. Gli "ospiti" vengono rimpiccioliti fino a raggiungere una dimensione adeguata alla Casa Ospitale e possono temporaneamente entrare per un tour. Durante questo processo, anche gli oggetti personali degli ospiti vengono rimpiccioliti insieme a loro e continuano a funzionare normalmente. L'effetto rimpicciolente dura 7 minuti, dopodiché gli "ospiti" vengono teletrasportati all'esterno della Casa Ospitale e riportati alle loro dimensioni originali. Aprire di nuovo la porta consente un altro tour, ma ogni visita è limitata a 7 minuti. Questo ha causato non poche frustrazioni ai registi che speravano di usare gli interni della Casa Ospitale per le riprese.
Il limite di restringimento non si applica a coloro che la Casa Ospitale riconosce come "padroni" o "nemici". Questi individui non ritornano automaticamente alle dimensioni normali dopo il restringimento, e solo il "padrone" sa come ripristinarli. La Casa Ospitale è solida come un vero castello, permettendo a questa Anomalia altrimenti innocua di proteggere il suo "padrone" o di intrappolare i "nemici" quando necessario. Una volta, un ladro toccò accidentalmente la porta della Casa Ospitale e rimase rimpicciolito per un'intera notte. Solo dopo aver giurato al "padrone" della Casa Ospitale che avrebbe cambiato vita, fu riportato alle sue dimensioni originali.

La lunga esistenza della Casa Ospitale senza annullamento ha stuzzicato la curiosità di alcuni studiosi: qual è il suo Nexus? Una teoria, che attinge alla leggenda, suggerisce che il Nexus della Casa Ospitale sia la sua "patria", il luogo in cui è nata. Sebbene non sia verificabile, la "patria" della Casa Ospitale è probabilmente un insediamento che esiste ancora. Fino a quando quel luogo non verrà distrutto, la Casa Ospitale continuerà ad esistere. Questo spiega anche perché l'arredamento e le strutture della Casa Ospitale si mantengano al passo con i tempi. Lo sviluppo della sua patria si riflette nella Casa Ospitale, ed essa si diletta a mostrare ai visitatori i progressi della sua città natale.
Questa teoria non è stata confermata, ma secondo chi scrive è piuttosto romantica. Per un'Anomalia con molte leggende che è sicura e innocua, mantenere la sua mistica e lasciare spazio all'immaginazione potrebbe essere il risultato migliore.

Caratteristiche dell'Anomalia
· Appare come uno squisito modello di castello in miniatura.
· Dopo aver aperto la porta della Casa Ospitale, gli umani entro un certo raggio (così come alcune Stranezze) vengono riconosciuti come "ospiti" dalla Casa Ospitale e rimpiccioliti a una dimensione che consente loro di visitare il castello.
· L'effetto rimpicciolente dura 7 minuti. Suonare l'organo a canne all'interno della Casa Ospitale può far terminare il tour in anticipo e ripristinare i visitatori alle dimensioni originali.
· Il limite di tempo di 7 minuti non si applica a coloro che la Casa Ospitale riconosce come "padroni" o "nemici". Solo il "padrone" della Casa Ospitale sa come ripristinarli.

Nexus dell'Anomalia
Sconosciuto

Valutazione del Rischio

If this world holds only sorrow, then rest here awhile.

Anomaly Story
R-4321[Ob] "Dimension Visitor" is, in essence, an ancient nautical astrolabe. Beyond locating physical directions such as north, south, east, and west, as well as the positions of stars in the cosmos, it possesses a strange ability: it can point toward where the heart belongs, the path to hidden treasure, those with potential, and more. The ancient astrolabe was kept in an equally ancient hidden village. The villagers used it and worshiped it, yet they never spoke of it to outsiders, nor did they use its power for immoral ends. Grateful for their kindness, it formed a contract with the villagers and granted them long lives.
Those peaceful days lasted until word of the "long-lived village" eventually reached the outside world. Rumors grew and spread until the villagers were forced to leave their home and become trapped in a cruel "game." Tragically, the village's already scarce bloodline was completely extinguished in that game, and the organizers were disappointed to discover that they truly were only ordinary people who lived a little longer. Realizing that everything they had done had been meaningless, the powerful complained and walked away. Dimension Visitor was left adrift amid this undeserved chaos. Yet to the very end, everyone still prayed to it and protected their shared secret. Dimension Visitor felt confusion, bewilderment, and endless loneliness. But how was it supposed to process emotions that "should have belonged to humans"? Unfortunately, the astrolabe could not point the way to its own future. Thus, it developed a desire to "escape," giving birth to the Anomalous Realm known as the Corridor of Echoes.
Taking on the appearance of its last contract bearer, Dimension Visitor has wandered for ages at the entrance to the Corridor of Echoes, fulfilling the astrolabe's original purpose: speaking with every visitor likewise drowned in the past and guiding them toward "escape." The present no longer exists, and even the future will someday become the past. Perhaps in this way, it can forever keep the contractors it once knew, and the kind people who live on in its memories.

Characteristics
Its true form is an ancient nautical astrolabe with a strange ability to form contracts with people and grant them long life.
After all of its contract bearers passed away, the astrolabe was left adrift. It eventually took on the appearance of its final contractor and began wandering the entrance to the Corridor of Echoes, an Anomalous Realm born from its will.
It speaks with every visitor similarly lost in the past and guides them toward "escape."

Low risk.

Unique Anomaly. Not currently contained.

Through rain and shine, the vines live on.

Anomaly Story
.Roughly a dozen years ago, a forest fire broke out in the mountains near Hethereau. The flames spread with alarming speed, making the situation extremely difficult to control. At the same time, abnormal fluctuations in the Wertheimer Index were detected within the fire zone, making any reckless entry potentially dangerous. Just as the firefighters found themselves unable to advance or retreat, they saw a giant vine rise from the center of the burning area. What followed was a localized downpour that lasted more than ten hours. The fire was extinguished in time, but the rain was so heavy that the forest became marshland. After extensive experiments and research, scholars determined that the giant vine had been formed by many smaller vines of the same kind winding together and expanding. The vine-like Anomaly that had rendered such great service during the fire was therefore collectively named R-2340[Or], also known as "Weather Vine."
As its name suggests, Weather Vine can alter the weather in a small area according to its own condition. The fastest way to distinguish it from ordinary vines is to check whether one or more drop-shaped blue "Vine Pearls" grow on its tendrils. When it senses a lack of water, Weather Vine disregards the local geography and causes rain to fall in the surrounding area to water itself. Researchers found that the plant rapidly expands when burned by flame, increasing the range over which it can alter the weather. However, this behavior is undoubtedly devastating to Weather Vine itself. After the forest fire mentioned above, the giant Weather Vine gradually returned to its original size, but the exhausted plants permanently lost their Vine Pearls and became no different from ordinary vines. Some even withered away. Around those dried vines, however, people found new plants quietly taking root. This clever Anomaly had used cooperation to withstand disaster and protect the seeds of its group.
Weather Vine's remarkable ability allows it to survive almost anywhere it can take root. Even in barren places where living creatures are rarely seen, traces of its green can still be found. For this reason, Weather Vine has become a top choice for beginners interested in growing potted plants. After all, who wouldn't want a few evergreen plants on their balcony that never need watering? However, before raising one, be sure to report it to the local Bureau of Anomaly Control office and the fire department.

Characteristics
·Weather Vine is a vine-like Anomaly that can alter the weather in a small area based on its own condition. Its tendrils grow one or more drop-shaped blue "Vine Pearls." When it senses a lack of water, it disregards the local geography and causes rain to fall nearby.
When burned by flame, it rapidly expands to increase the range of rainfall. However, if the rain lasts too long, Weather Vine will lose its "Vine Pearls" afterward and become no different from an ordinary vine.

Anomaly Nexus
Continuous burning by flame.

Risk Assessment
Basically harmless.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Three specimens are contained at the Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures
Plant Weather Vine in a containment unit with ample soil and sunlight.

Experiment Record
Experiment 1:
Researchers cut off a Weather Vine tendril bearing a "Vine Pearl," then burned both the section with the "Vine Pearl" and the remaining section. The section with the "Vine Pearl" could still produce rain in its surroundings, while the other showed no response. Conclusion: the "Vine Pearl" is the key organ that allows Weather Vine to alter the weather.

Experiment 2:
Researchers attempted to separate the "Vine Pearl" from the main body. However, once removed from the vine, the "Vine Pearl" immediately evaporated, making further experiments impossible for now.
Translation:
Attraverso la pioggia e il sole, le liane vivono.

Storia dell'Anomalia
Circa una dozzina di anni fa, è scoppiato un incendio boschivo sulle montagne vicino a Hethereau. Le fiamme si sono diffuse a una velocità allarmante, rendendo la situazione estremamente difficile da controllare. Allo stesso tempo, sono state rilevate fluttuazioni anomale nell'Indice Wertheimer all'interno della zona dell'incendio, rendendo potenzialmente pericoloso qualsiasi ingresso avventato. Proprio mentre i vigili del fuoco si trovavano impossibilitati ad avanzare o ritirarsi, hanno visto una liana gigante innalzarsi dal centro dell'area in fiamme. Quello che ne è seguito è stato un acquazzone localizzato che è durato più di dieci ore. L'incendio è stato domato in tempo, ma la pioggia è stata così forte che la foresta è diventata una palude. Dopo ampi esperimenti e ricerche, gli studiosi hanno stabilito che la liana gigante era stata formata da molte liane più piccole dello stesso tipo che si avvolgevano insieme e si espandevano. L'Anomalia simile a una liana che aveva reso un servizio così grande durante l'incendio è stata quindi chiamata collettivamente R-2340[Or], nota anche come "Liana Meteorologica".
Come suggerisce il nome, la Liana Meteorologica può alterare il tempo in una piccola area a seconda delle sue condizioni. Il modo più rapido per distinguerla dalle normali liane è controllare se una o più "Perle di Liana" blu a forma di goccia crescono sui suoi viticci. Quando avverte una mancanza d'acqua, la Liana Meteorologica ignora la geografia locale e fa cadere la pioggia nell'area circostante per annaffiarsi. I ricercatori hanno scoperto che la pianta si espande rapidamente quando viene bruciata dalle fiamme, aumentando il raggio in cui può alterare il clima. Tuttavia, questo comportamento è indubbiamente devastante per la stessa Liana Meteorologica. Dopo l'incendio boschivo menzionato in precedenza, la Liana Meteorologica gigante è tornata gradualmente alle sue dimensioni originali, ma le piante esauste hanno perso permanentemente le loro Perle di Liana e sono diventate non diverse dalle normali liane. Alcune si sono persino seccate. Intorno a quelle liane secche, tuttavia, le persone hanno trovato nuove piante che mettevano radici silenziosamente. Questa intelligente Anomalia aveva usato la cooperazione per resistere al disastro e proteggere i semi del suo gruppo.
La straordinaria capacità della Liana Meteorologica le consente di sopravvivere quasi ovunque possa mettere radici. Anche in luoghi aridi in cui si vedono raramente creature viventi, si possono ancora trovare tracce del suo verde. Per questo motivo, la Liana Meteorologica è diventata la scelta principale per i principianti interessati alla coltivazione di piante in vaso. Dopotutto, chi non vorrebbe sul proprio balcone qualche pianta sempreverde che non ha mai bisogno di essere annaffiata? Tuttavia, prima di coltivarne una, assicurati di segnalarlo all'Ufficio Anomalie locale e ai vigili del fuoco.

Caratteristiche
·La Liana Meteorologica è un'Anomalia simile a una liana che può alterare il clima in una piccola area in base alle sue condizioni. I suoi viticci producono una o più "Perle di Liana" blu a forma di goccia. Quando avverte una mancanza d'acqua, ignora la geografia locale e fa cadere la pioggia nelle vicinanze.
Quando viene bruciata dalle fiamme, si espande rapidamente per aumentare il raggio della pioggia. Tuttavia, se la pioggia dura troppo a lungo, in seguito la Liana Meteorologica perderà le sue "Perle di Liana" e non si distinguerà da una normale liana.

Nexus dell'Anomalia
Bruciatura continua da parte delle fiamme.

Valutazione del Rischio
Fondamentalmente innocua.

Stato di Contenimento/Garanzia
Tre esemplari sono contenuti nel Complesso di Celaeno.

Misure di Contenimento
Piantare la Liana Meteorologica in un'unità di contenimento con ampia terra e luce solare.

Registro degli Esperimenti
Esperimento 1:
I ricercatori hanno tagliato un viticcio della Liana Meteorologica recante una "Perla di Liana", quindi hanno bruciato sia la sezione con la "Perla di Liana" sia la sezione rimanente. La sezione con la "Perla di Liana" poteva ancora produrre pioggia nei suoi dintorni, mentre l'altra non mostrava alcuna risposta. Conclusione: la "Perla di Liana" è l'organo chiave che consente alla Liana Meteorologica di alterare il clima.

Esperimento 2:
I ricercatori hanno tentato di separare la "Perla di Liana" dal corpo principale. Tuttavia, una volta rimossa dalla liana, la "Perla di Liana" è evaporata immediatamente, rendendo al momento impossibili ulteriori esperimenti.

A warm and snuggly hug.

Anomaly Story:
Kids love cuddling their stuffed animals. Plenty of children grow up with at least one plush, bear-shaped friend. That bear is a diehard partner in crime, right up until the kid matures and the stuffed animal gets left behind in a closet or on a shelf somewhere.

The Phenomenon Anomaly, "Cuddly Bear", only manifests in toys adored by children. Its arrival seems to be visible to children only. Once affected, the toy becomes "alive" in the eyes of a child, while apparently remaining a normal stuffed animal to adults. Despite the name "Cuddly Bear", the toy's actual form depends on the child's preferences, and isn't limited specifically to bears.
From the moment a Cuddly Bear is born, it is dedicated towards one objective—to stay by its owner's side, grow up with them, listen to their troubles, and make sure they never feel alone. As the child grows and gradually becomes more independent, they stop needing their stuffed animal. When that time comes, the Cuddly Bear naturally undergoes nullification and reverts to being an ordinary toy.
Aside from providing emotional support, Cuddly Bears have no other effects. When the time for nullification arrives, most Cuddly Bears accept their fate with grace. However, there are always exceptions. Some refuse to disappear, causing their host toys to gain physical mobility and sentience, thus transforming into Derivative Anomalies. Those who are saddened by the "adults" who no longer need them become "Saddy Teddies", while those who harbor resentment toward the "child" who abandoned them become "Teehee Bears". Driven by grudges and animosity, a Cuddly Bear that has turned into a Derivative Anomaly will actively threaten the target of its anger.

In general, a person will encounter their very own Cuddly Bear once in a lifetime. So far, there are no recorded cases of a new Cuddly Bear manifesting on the same child's toys after the previous one has undergone nullification. However, "maturing" does not seem to be an absolute requirement for Cuddly Bear nullification. In a select few cases, there have been Cuddly Bear owners who, even as adults, still can't part with their Cuddly Bear. In such cases, the Cuddly Bear's duration of existence far exceeds the norm.

Characteristics:
· When an ordinary toy is affected by this Anomaly, it moves and acts—within the child's perception—in whatever way the child desires.
· It has no real physical capabilities and only serves to provide emotional value to the child.

Anomaly Nexus:
As the child matures, and the Cuddly Bear is no longer needed and is gradually forgotten, the Anomaly undergoes nullification—typically resulting in the Cuddly Bear returning to its initial stuffed animal state.

Risk Assessment:
Low Risk.

Containment Status:
Due to its unique Nexus, no Cuddly Bear has been contained to date.

Source:
A carp emerges from the chasm of heaven, the tide flows back through the mortal realm. The Dragon Gate stands tall and timeless, ever awaiting the return of shimmering scales.

Anomaly Story
As one of the oldest anomalies, Tidal Ascension has existed in this world long before paper and pens. Whenever it manifests, it is accompanied by gentle rain falling from the sky and all vegetation sprouting forth into spring. Even the most barren and desolate lands are revitalized. Thus, in an age when every blade of grass was sacred, Tidal Ascension was regarded as an auspicious blessing from the heavens. Simple folk would hold feasts and celebrations of song and dance, commemorating this phenomenon through various ceremonial traditions. Yet one ritual was performed everywhere without exception: the leaping of the Dragon Gate.
When the ritual began, people would construct a towering Dragon Gate. The Skyfish Banners that migrated along with the Tidal Ascension phenomenon would then compete to leap over it, while skilled performers would cleverly maneuver against them, preventing them from crossing the Dragon Gate. Yes, I said preventing, not assisting. This has been the custom since ancient times, and even though the reasons for it have long since faded into obscurity, later generations have continued to follow it strictly. Needless to say, such a fantastical and grand performance won the adoration of all children, and so Tidal Ascension took on another layer of meaning: to fulfill childhood dreams together with the youth, so that they would carry a heart that never loses its innocence.
The ethereal colorful carps have no physical form and cannot actually be harmed or blocked, but they respond to their opponents' actions accordingly. Stopping them is not difficult, as if this spectacle itself deliberately cooperates with humans to present the Dragon Gate trial more romantically to the eyes of eager children. When encountering obstacles, the carp blow bubbles, trapping those who block them from leaping over the Dragon Gate. These light bubbles carry the people inside up into the air before gently floating back down, and so children eagerly join in. Weighing less, children often fly higher, high enough to vanish amidst the clouds and glimpse the homeland of the carp. Such rituals would eventually transform into joyful games, and the carp would complete their Dragon Gate trial amidst laughter. The translucent colorful carp that failed to leap over the Dragon Gate would wave their tails and ascend like fireworks, gradually vanishing into the distant sky. Thus the celebration would come to a perfect close, and the children would continue to grow while cherishing the beautiful memories of that day.
This celebration continued until a certain ceremony in a certain place in a certain year. In retrospect, it was likely that some curious young people deliberately allowed the carp to successfully leap over the Dragon Gate…
A witness once told their children and grandchildren what happened that day: it was an extraordinarily magnificent dragon, rising from the Faraway land. "A great dragon made of countless colorful carp! It circled round and round in the sky, with fish constantly swimming into its body from all directions. Then a river in the sky descended to meet it, and the dragon followed that heavenly stream back into the clouds."
It was not until several days later, when the last of the fish had scattered and vanished, that people discovered everyone who had participated in the ceremony at that place had disappeared. Where the village once stood was now silent, yet the vegetation had grown astonishingly lush… Even the tallest chimney was covered in countless flowers. Some said they were punished for angering the spirits with their irreverence toward the ritual. Others said they were chosen by the dragon formed from fish and taken to the heavens, becoming new colorful carp awaiting the next migration.
However, all we can confirm is that this Anomaly may cause extraordinary consequences after evolving, that is, after successfully leaping over the Dragon Gate. From every perspective, we should do our utmost to avoid repeating this mistake. As recorded in ancient texts restored by archaeologists: "…The shimmering scales came from the nine heavens in great numbers, seeking to cross the Dragon Gate. Wherever they passed, sweet rain fell upon the world and all vegetation was revived. All people celebrated, and this became an established custom, passed down through generations… To prevent disaster, there is but one rule: they must not be allowed to cross the Dragon Gate."
Regrettably, after more and more people learned the truth, it became impossible to approach this phenomenon with the same pure innocence as before. The ritual of leaping the Dragon Gate has gradually become an ancient ceremony only found in history books… The children of yesteryear have long been swallowed by the river of time, remembered by none… Only the colorful carp still return to the human world, and again.

Anomaly Characteristics
· Accompanying that slender river from the heavens, the translucent fish shadows that migrate here seek the trial of leaping over the Dragon Gate.
· Ignores geographic conditions. Able to revitalize the surrounding area.
· Failed trials result in a 'return to the sky', while successful ones cause the Anomaly to evolve.

Anomaly Nexus
Help the Skyfish Banner complete the challenge of leaping over the Dragon Gate, regardless of whether they succeed or fail.

Risk Assessment
Generally does not attack proactively. Can serve as city scenery.

Containment/Guarantee Status
Cannot be contained.

Containment Measures
Not in containment.

Experiment Records
/
